en: And it happened that when Jesus said these words he perceived there were some among them who had marveled, and wondered what he’d concerning the law of Moses; for they don’t understood the saying that old things had passed away, and that all things had become new.

en: And then when Jesus spoke these words, he perceived there were a few among them who’d marveled and wondered what he had concerning the Mosaic law; for they don’t comprehend the saying that old things had died, and that all things had become new.

en: And it came to pass that when Jesus had said these words he perceived that there were some among them who marveled, and wondered what he would concerning the law of Moses; for they understood not the saying that old things had passed away, and that all things had become new.

en: And then we found on the promised land, as we journeyed in the wilderness, that there were beasts of every kind in the forests, both cow and ox, and donkey and horse, and goat and wild goat, and all manners of wild animals, which were for the men’s use.

en: And it came to pass that we did find upon the land of promise, as we journeyed in the wilderness, that there were beasts in the forests of every kind, both the cow and the ox, and the ass and the horse, and the goat and the wild goat, and all manner of wild animals, which were for the use of men.
nv: áádóó kéyah bee ahaʼdeetʼánígíí bikáaʼgi, doo kééhatʼínígi neiikaigo, naaldlooshii ałʼąą átʼáo deiiltsą́, béégashii dóó bedaałtʼéhígíí, tʼáá áła, índa télii dóó łį́į́ʼ, índa tłʼízí dóó tłʼízí daʼałchinígíí, dóó naaldlooshii ałʼąą ádaatʼéii, diné choodoołʼįįłígíí bikʼídaniitą́ą́ʼ.

en: And now it happened that when Jesus said these words he told them again, after he’d expounded all scriptures to them that they’d received, he told them: Look, other scriptures I’d suggest you should write, that you haven’t.
nv: áádóó kʼad díí jesus saad yee hachʼįʼ haadzíiʼgo ánááhodiʼní, díí diyin god bizaad ndajijaahą́ą ałtso hachʼįʼ nááyíltaʼgo, kóyidííniid: jó, diyin god bizaad nááná łaʼ, doo ndaajaahígíí, éí ałdóʼ bikááʼ ádoohłííł nisin.

en: And now it happened that there were a great crowd gathered together, of the people of Nephi, round about the temple that was in the land Bountiful; and they were in awe and wondering one with another, and were showing one another the great and marvelous change that had taken place.
nv: áádóó kʼad nephi bidineʼé, tʼóó ahayóí áłah silį́įʼgo, kéyah hwiináago hoolyéhę́ęgi sodizin bá hooghan siʼánę́ę binaagóó; dóó díí hoł ádahóótʼįįdę́ę dóó łahgo ádahootʼé dahazlį́ʼígíí bee ahił dahojilneʼgo, ákweʼé áłah jílį́.

en: And then there was a large crowd gathered together, of Nephi’s people, round about the temple that was in the land of Bountiful; and they were in shock and pondering one with another, and were showing each other the great and marvelous change that took place.

en: And now it came to pass that there were a great multitude gathered together, of the people of Nephi, round about the temple which was in the land Bountiful; and they were marveling and wondering one with another, and were showing one to another the great and marvelous change which had taken place.
nv: áádóó kʼad nephi bidineʼé, tʼóó ahayóí áłah silį́įʼgo, kéyah hwiináago hoolyéhę́ęgi sodizin bá hooghan siʼánę́ę binaagóó; dóó díí hoł ádahóótʼįįdę́ę dóó łahgo ádahootʼé dahazlį́ʼígíí bee ahił dahojilneʼgo, ákweʼé áłah jílį́.

en: And now it happened that according to our record, and we know our record to be valid, for behold, it was the just man who kept record—for he truly performed many miracles in the name of Jesus; and there wasn’t any man who could perform a miracle in the name of Jesus save he were cleansed fully from his iniquity—
nv: áádóó kʼad nihaa haneʼ ndeitʼáhígíí bikʼehgo, díí nihaa haneʼígíí éí tʼáá aaníí átʼéego nihił béédahózin, jó háálá, diné tsʼídá yáʼátʼéehii éí haneʼ yaa áhályą́ą́ ńtʼę́ę́ʼ—háálá tʼáá aaníí jesus bízhiʼ binahjįʼ álílee naalnish ńtʼę́ę́ʼ; dóó doo éí tʼáá yigáłígíí jesus bízhiʼ binahjįʼ álílee naalnish da doo tʼáá hazhóʼó bąąhági átʼéii tsʼídá bąąh ádingo tʼéiyá—

en: And then according to our record, and we know our record to be true, for look, it was the just man who retained records—for he truly performed many miracles in Jesus’ name; and there was no man who could perform a miracle in Jesus name as from when he were cleansed fully from his iniquity—
nv: áádóó kʼad nihaa haneʼ ndeitʼáhígíí bikʼehgo, díí nihaa haneʼígíí éí tʼáá aaníí átʼéego nihił béédahózin, jó háálá, diné tsʼídá yáʼátʼéehii éí haneʼ yaa áhályą́ą́ ńtʼę́ę́ʼ—háálá tʼáá aaníí jesus bízhiʼ binahjįʼ álílee naalnish ńtʼę́ę́ʼ; dóó doo éí tʼáá yigáłígíí jesus bízhiʼ binahjįʼ álílee naalnish da doo tʼáá hazhóʼó bąąhági átʼéii tsʼídá bąąh ádingo tʼéiyá—

nv: áádóó kʼad nihaa haneʼ ndeitʼáhígíí bikʼehgo, díí nihaa haneʼígíí éí tʼáá aaníí átʼéego nihił béédahózin, jó háálá, diné tsʼídá yáʼátʼéehii éí haneʼ yaa áhályą́ą́ ńtʼę́ę́ʼ—háálá tʼáá aaníí jesus bízhiʼ binahjįʼ álílee naalnish ńtʼę́ę́ʼ; dóó doo éí tʼáá yigáłígíí jesus bízhiʼ binahjįʼ álílee naalnish da doo tʼáá hazhóʼó bąąhági átʼéii tsʼídá bąąh ádingo tʼéiyá—

en: And now it happened that in the three hundred sixty-third year the Nephites went up with their armies to battle against the Lamanites, from the land Desolation.

en: And then in the three hundred sixty-third year, the Nephites traveled up with their armies to engage the Lamanites, from the land Desolation.

en: And now it came to pass that in the three hundred and sixty and third year the Nephites did go up with their armies to battle against the Lamanites, out of the land Desolation.

en: And now it happened this year, yes, in the two hundred thirty-first year, there was a great schism among the people.
nv: áádóó kʼad tʼáá díí yíhaiígíí biyiʼ, aooʼ, naakidi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan tádiin dóó baʼaan tʼááłáʼí góneʼ yihahgo, diné tʼóó ahayóígo ałtsʼáhaazná.

en: And now it came to pass in this year, yea, in the two hundred and thirty and first year, there was a great division among the people.

en: And now it happened, if there was no mistake made by this man in the reckoning of our time, a thirty-third year had passed;
nv: áádóó kʼad, díí diné doo asiihgóó nihił yoołkáłígíí yiyííłtaʼgo, éí kʼad tádiin dóó baʼaan tááʼ nááhai;

en: And then if there was no mistake made by this man in reckoning of our time, the thirty-third year had passed;
nv: áádóó kʼad, díí diné doo asiihgóó nihił yoołkáłígíí yiyííłtaʼgo, éí kʼad tádiin dóó baʼaan tááʼ nááhai;

en: And now it came to pass, if there was no mistake made by this man in the reckoning of our time, the thirty-third year had passed away;
nv: áádóó kʼad, díí diné doo asiihgóó nihił yoołkáłígíí yiyííłtaʼgo, éí kʼad tádiin dóó baʼaan tááʼ nááhai;

en: And it came to pass that when two hundred ten years had passed there were many churches in the land; yes, there were many churches which professed to know the Christ, and yet they did deny the more parts of his gospel, insomuch that they did receive all manner of wickedness, and did administer that which was sacred unto him to whom it had been forbidden because of unworthiness.
nv: áádóó naakidi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan neeznáá ałtso nááhaigo kéyah bikááʼgóó tʼóó ahayóí ałʼąą átʼéego sodizin bá hooghan bee dah daʼíldééh silį́į́ʼ; aooʼ, ląʼída éí sodizin bá hooghan christ beedahoniilzin daaní, dóó ákondi ląʼída binaʼnitin doo dayoodlą́ą da, áko índa bąąhági átʼéii bił yah anááʼookai silį́į́ʼ, dóó éí biniinaa éí tsʼídá íiyisíí diyingo baa ntshákeesgo bąąhági átʼéii bee dahólǫ́ǫgo tʼáadoo bidaʼołʼíní dabiʼdooʼniidę́ę, éí ákótʼéego yaa ńdiikai.

en: And it happened that in commencement of the ninety-second year, behold, prophecies of the prophets began to be fulfilled more fully; for there started to be greater signs and greater miracles performed among the people.
nv: áádóó náhástʼédiin dóó baʼaan naaki náháahgo, jó, diyin god yá dahalneʼii náásgóó yaa dahalneʼę́ę hózhǫ́ bidaʼalnééh silį́į́ʼ, háálá diné bitahgóó binahjįʼ éédahózinii dóó álílee naʼanish konishghánígo áhoonííł silį́į́ʼ.

en: And then at the beginning of the ninety-second year, look, prophecies of the prophets began being fulfilled more fully; for there started being greater signs and greater miracles performed among the people.
nv: áádóó náhástʼédiin dóó baʼaan naaki náháahgo, jó, diyin god yá dahalneʼii náásgóó yaa dahalneʼę́ę hózhǫ́ bidaʼalnééh silį́į́ʼ, háálá diné bitahgóó binahjįʼ éédahózinii dóó álílee naʼanish konishghánígo áhoonííł silį́į́ʼ.

en: And it happened that the ninety-third year also passed in peace, save it were for the Gadianton robbers, who dwelled in the mountains, who infested the land; for so strong their holds were and their secret places that the people couldn’t overpower them; therefore they committed many murders, and slaughtered many among the people.
nv: áádóó náhástʼédiin doo baʼaan tááʼ éí ałdóʼ ahodeezyeelgo ałtso nínáánááhai, tʼáá hazhóʼó gadianton bidaʼniʼįįhii, dziłyiʼgo kéédahatʼínígíí tʼéiyá diné yitahgóó nikidadiikai, tsʼídá ndahonitłʼahgo ńdanitʼingo kéédahatʼį́įgo biniinaa chʼééh bikʼeh daazhdidleeh; éí bąą diné ndeistseed, dóó tʼóó ahayóí diné dayíígą́ą́ʼ.

en: And then the ninety-third year also passed peacefully, as from when it was for the Gadianton robbers, who dwelled within the mountains, who infested the land; for so strong were their holds and their secret places that people couldn’t overpower them; therefore they committed several murders and slaughtered many among the people.
nv: áádóó náhástʼédiin doo baʼaan tááʼ éí ałdóʼ ahodeezyeelgo ałtso nínáánááhai, tʼáá hazhóʼó gadianton bidaʼniʼįįhii, dziłyiʼgo kéédahatʼínígíí tʼéiyá diné yitahgóó nikidadiikai, tsʼídá ndahonitłʼahgo ńdanitʼingo kéédahatʼį́įgo biniinaa chʼééh bikʼeh daazhdidleeh; éí bąą diné ndeistseed, dóó tʼóó ahayóí diné dayíígą́ą́ʼ.

en: And it came to pass that the ninety and third year did also pass away in peace, save it were for the Gadianton robbers, who dwelt upon the mountains, who did infest the land; for so strong were their holds and their secret places that the people could not overpower them; therefore they did commit many murders, and did do much slaughter among the people.
nv: áádóó náhástʼédiin doo baʼaan tááʼ éí ałdóʼ ahodeezyeelgo ałtso nínáánááhai, tʼáá hazhóʼó gadianton bidaʼniʼįįhii, dziłyiʼgo kéédahatʼínígíí tʼéiyá diné yitahgóó nikidadiikai, tsʼídá ndahonitłʼahgo ńdanitʼingo kéédahatʼį́įgo biniinaa chʼééh bikʼeh daazhdidleeh; éí bąą diné ndeistseed, dóó tʼóó ahayóí diné dayíígą́ą́ʼ.

en: And it happened that when the thunder, and the lightning, and the storm, and the tempest, and the earthquake ceased—for behold, they lasted for about the span of three hours; and it was said by some that the time was greater; nevertheless, all these great and terrible things were done in about the span of three hours—and then behold, there was darkness upon the surface of the land.
nv: áádóó ndaʼdiʼnínę́ę dóó ndaʼdilchʼil yę́ę, dóó níłtsą́ bił deeyol yę́ę, dóó niʼ nahaʼnánę́ę áhodiilzeeʼ—jó háálá tsʼídá daatsʼí tááʼ ahééʼilkidgo índa niʼ kódzaa; dóó łaʼ ádaaníigo éí tʼáá íiyisíí hodíinaʼ daaní; ákótʼée ndi, díí ákóhóótʼįįdígíí éí tááʼ ahééʼilkidjįʼ áhoodzaa—jó áádóó índa, niʼ bikááʼgóó ałtso chahóółhéél.

en: And then when the thunder and the lightning and the storm and the tempest and the earthquake ceased—for look, they lasted for about the timespan of three hours; and it was said by some that the time was longer; nevertheless, all these great and horrible things were done within about the timespan of three hours—and then look, there was darkness upon the face of the land.
nv: áádóó ndaʼdiʼnínę́ę dóó ndaʼdilchʼil yę́ę, dóó níłtsą́ bił deeyol yę́ę, dóó niʼ nahaʼnánę́ę áhodiilzeeʼ—jó háálá tsʼídá daatsʼí tááʼ ahééʼilkidgo índa niʼ kódzaa; dóó łaʼ ádaaníigo éí tʼáá íiyisíí hodíinaʼ daaní; ákótʼée ndi, díí ákóhóótʼįįdígíí éí tááʼ ahééʼilkidjįʼ áhoodzaa—jó áádóó índa, niʼ bikááʼgóó ałtso chahóółhéél.

en: And it came to pass that when the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the storm, and the tempest, and the quakings of the earth did cease—for behold, they did last for about the space of three hours; and it was said by some that the time was greater; nevertheless, all these great and terrible things were done in about the space of three hours—and then behold, there was darkness upon the face of the land.
nv: áádóó ndaʼdiʼnínę́ę dóó ndaʼdilchʼil yę́ę, dóó níłtsą́ bił deeyol yę́ę, dóó niʼ nahaʼnánę́ę áhodiilzeeʼ—jó háálá tsʼídá daatsʼí tááʼ ahééʼilkidgo índa niʼ kódzaa; dóó łaʼ ádaaníigo éí tʼáá íiyisíí hodíinaʼ daaní; ákótʼée ndi, díí ákóhóótʼįįdígíí éí tááʼ ahééʼilkidjįʼ áhoodzaa—jó áádóó índa, niʼ bikááʼgóó ałtso chahóółhéél.

en: And then the Nephites gathered together a great crowd of men, even exceeding thirty thousand.
nv: áádóó nephi bidineʼé éí diné ahąąh ádayiilaa, tádiin dóó baʼaandi mííl yázhí ndi.

en: And it came to pass that the Nephites had gathered together a great number of men, even to exceed the number of thirty thousand.
nv: áádóó nephi bidineʼé éí diné ahąąh ádayiilaa, tádiin dóó baʼaandi mííl yázhí ndi.

en: And then Nephi went into the water and was baptized.
nv: áádóó nephi taah yíyá dóó tó bee biʼdoolzį́į́ʼ.

en: And it came to pass that Nephi went down into the water and was baptized.
nv: áádóó nephi taah yíyá dóó tó bee biʼdoolzį́į́ʼ.

en: And it happened that they came to battle us, and every soul was filled with terror because of the vastness of their numbers.
nv: áádóó nihaatiih yíkai, dóó atsʼíís dóó ayiʼsizíinii tʼáá átʼé ndajisdzííd háálá áájí tʼóó ahayóígíí biniinaa.

en: And then they arrived to battle us, and every soul was filled with fear because of the immensity of their numbers.
nv: áádóó nihaatiih yíkai, dóó atsʼíís dóó ayiʼsizíinii tʼáá átʼé ndajisdzííd háálá áájí tʼóó ahayóígíí biniinaa.

en: And it came to pass that they came to battle against us, and every soul was filled with terror because of the greatness of their numbers.
nv: áádóó nihaatiih yíkai, dóó atsʼíís dóó ayiʼsizíinii tʼáá átʼé ndajisdzííd háálá áájí tʼóó ahayóígíí biniinaa.

en: And it happened that we traveled for about four days, nearly in a south-southeast heading, and we pitched our tents again; and we gave the place the name Shazer.
nv: áádóó shádiʼááh dóó haʼaʼaah bichʼíjígo yiiʼnéełgo dį́į́ʼ yiską́, dóó nihiníbaal nináádahisiiʼnil; dóó nihiiʼnánígíí shazer bee deíníijiʼ.

en: And then we traveled about four days, nearly in a south-southeast direction, and we again pitched our tents; and we named the place Shazer.
nv: áádóó shádiʼááh dóó haʼaʼaah bichʼíjígo yiiʼnéełgo dį́į́ʼ yiską́, dóó nihiníbaal nináádahisiiʼnil; dóó nihiiʼnánígíí shazer bee deíníijiʼ.

en: And it came to pass that we traveled for the space of four days, nearly a south-southeast direction, and we did pitch our tents again; and we did call the name of the place Shazer.
nv: áádóó shádiʼááh dóó haʼaʼaah bichʼíjígo yiiʼnéełgo dį́į́ʼ yiską́, dóó nihiníbaal nináádahisiiʼnil; dóó nihiiʼnánígíí shazer bee deíníijiʼ.

en: And it happened that after they’d bound me so much that I couldn’t move, the compass, which had been prepared by the Lord, ceased to work.
nv: áádóó shedaʼaztłǫ́ǫgo áko índa doo nahashnáágóó ádashiilaa índa, diikahjígo dah astsihii bóhólníihii nihainíʼánę́ę, doo naalnish da silį́į́ʼ.

en: And then after they had tied me up so much that I couldn’t move, the compass, that had been prepared by the Lord, quit working.
nv: áádóó shedaʼaztłǫ́ǫgo áko índa doo nahashnáágóó ádashiilaa índa, diikahjígo dah astsihii bóhólníihii nihainíʼánę́ę, doo naalnish da silį́į́ʼ.

en: And it came to pass that after they had bound me insomuch that I could not move, the compass, which had been prepared of the Lord, did cease to work.
nv: áádóó shedaʼaztłǫ́ǫgo áko índa doo nahashnáágóó ádashiilaa índa, diikahjígo dah astsihii bóhólníihii nihainíʼánę́ę, doo naalnish da silį́į́ʼ.

en: And it happened that I, Nephi, saw the pointers that were in the ball, that they worked according to faith and diligence and heed what we give them.
nv: áádóó shí, nephi, béésh nímaz yę́ę biyiʼdóó béésh dah atsih yę́ę, éí niheʼoodląʼ dóó haitʼáo baʼííníidlíhígíí índa haitʼáo bikʼeh dahoniilʼínígíí yikʼehgo naalnishgo yiiłtsą́.

en: And then I, Nephi, saw the pointers in the ball, that they worked according to faith and diligence and heed what we give to them.
nv: áádóó shí, nephi, béésh nímaz yę́ę biyiʼdóó béésh dah atsih yę́ę, éí niheʼoodląʼ dóó haitʼáo baʼííníidlíhígíí índa haitʼáo bikʼeh dahoniilʼínígíí yikʼehgo naalnishgo yiiłtsą́.

en: And it came to pass that I, Nephi, beheld the pointers which were in the ball, that they did work according to the faith and diligence and heed which we did give unto them.
nv: áádóó shí, nephi, béésh nímaz yę́ę biyiʼdóó béésh dah atsih yę́ę, éí niheʼoodląʼ dóó haitʼáo baʼííníidlíhígíí índa haitʼáo bikʼeh dahoniilʼínígíí yikʼehgo naalnishgo yiiłtsą́.

en: And it happened that I, Nephi, being very young, nevertheless being tall in stature, and also having great desires to know of God’s enigmas, why, I cried out to the Lord; and saw he visited me, and softened my heart that I believed all the words that had been spoken by my father; why, I didn’t rebel against him like to my brothers.
nv: áádóó shí, nephi, tʼahdii tsíłkéí nishłį́į ndi, ákótʼée ndi tʼáá nistsxaaz dóó, nisneez dóó ayóó sidziil, dóó ałdóʼ diyin god biyáʼátʼéehii íiyisíí shił bééhodoozįįł nisingo, ákohgo, tʼáá íiyisíí bóhólníihii bichʼįʼ sodeeszin; jó áádóó shaa níyá, dóó shijéí yilzhólígo áyiilaa áko tʼáá ałtso shizhéʼé saad yee yááłtiʼę́ę éí yisisdląąd; ákohgo tʼáadoo shínaaí akʼijįʼ yáłtiʼígi átʼáo akʼijįʼ yááłtiʼ da.

en: And then I, Nephi, being extremely young, nevertheless being tall in stature, and also having great wishes to know about the mysteries of God, why, I cried to the Lord and saw that he visited me and softened my heart that I believed every word spoken by my father; why, I didn’t rebel against him as to my brothers.
nv: áádóó shí, nephi, tʼahdii tsíłkéí nishłį́į ndi, ákótʼée ndi tʼáá nistsxaaz dóó, nisneez dóó ayóó sidziil, dóó ałdóʼ diyin god biyáʼátʼéehii íiyisíí shił bééhodoozįįł nisingo, ákohgo, tʼáá íiyisíí bóhólníihii bichʼįʼ sodeeszin; jó áádóó shaa níyá, dóó shijéí yilzhólígo áyiilaa áko tʼáá ałtso shizhéʼé saad yee yááłtiʼę́ę éí yisisdląąd; ákohgo tʼáadoo shínaaí akʼijįʼ yáłtiʼígi átʼáo akʼijįʼ yááłtiʼ da.

en: And it came to pass that I, Nephi, being exceedingly young, nevertheless being large in stature, and also having great desires to know of the mysteries of God, wherefore, I did cry unto the Lord; and behold he did visit me, and did soften my heart that I did believe all the words which had been spoken by my father; wherefore, I did not rebel against him like unto my brothers.
nv: áádóó shí, nephi, tʼahdii tsíłkéí nishłį́į ndi, ákótʼée ndi tʼáá nistsxaaz dóó, nisneez dóó ayóó sidziil, dóó ałdóʼ diyin god biyáʼátʼéehii íiyisíí shił bééhodoozįįł nisingo, ákohgo, tʼáá íiyisíí bóhólníihii bichʼįʼ sodeeszin; jó áádóó shaa níyá, dóó shijéí yilzhólígo áyiilaa áko tʼáá ałtso shizhéʼé saad yee yááłtiʼę́ę éí yisisdląąd; ákohgo tʼáadoo shínaaí akʼijįʼ yáłtiʼígi átʼáo akʼijįʼ yááłtiʼ da.

en: And it happened that when my father saw the things that were written on the ball, he greatly feared and trembled, and also my brothers and Ishmael’s sons and our wives.
nv: áádóó shizhéʼé béésh nímaz yę́ę tʼáadoo leʼé bikááʼ nááháasdzooígíí yiyiiłtsą́ągo, tʼáá íiyisíí násdzííd dóó bitah hoditłid silį́į́ʼ, dóó tʼáá shínaaí dóó ishmael beʼashiiké dóó danihichʼooní, ałdóʼ ńdaasdzííd.

en: And it came to pass that when my father beheld the things which were written upon the ball, he did fear and tremble exceedingly, and also my brethren and the sons of Ishmael and our wives.
nv: áádóó shizhéʼé béésh nímaz yę́ę tʼáadoo leʼé bikááʼ nááháasdzooígíí yiyiiłtsą́ągo, tʼáá íiyisíí násdzííd dóó bitah hoditłid silį́į́ʼ, dóó tʼáá shínaaí dóó ishmael beʼashiiké dóó danihichʼooní, ałdóʼ ńdaasdzííd.

en: And then my father spoke to her, saying: I know I’m a visionary man; for if I’d not seen God’s things in a vision I shouldn’t have known the goodness of God but had tarried at Jerusalem and had perished with my brothers.
nv: áádóó shizhéʼé shimá yichʼįʼ haadzíiʼ, kóyidííniidgo: tʼáá aaníí diné bił áhátʼíinii nishłį́; háálá diyin god bídéétʼiʼígíí tʼáadoo yiiłtsą́ą́góó éí diyin god biyáʼátʼéehii doo shił bééhózin da dooleeł ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, ndi tʼahdii jerusalemdi naasháago, dóó shikʼis bił shiʼdiisxį́į doo ńtʼę́ę́ʼ.

en: And it had come to pass that my father spake unto her, saying: I know that I am a visionary man; for if I had not seen the things of God in a vision I should not have known the goodness of God, but had tarried at Jerusalem, and had perished with my brethren.
nv: áádóó shizhéʼé shimá yichʼįʼ haadzíiʼ, kóyidííniidgo: tʼáá aaníí diné bił áhátʼíinii nishłį́; háálá diyin god bídéétʼiʼígíí tʼáadoo yiiłtsą́ą́góó éí diyin god biyáʼátʼéehii doo shił bééhózin da dooleeł ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, ndi tʼahdii jerusalemdi naasháago, dóó shikʼis bił shiʼdiisxį́į doo ńtʼę́ę́ʼ.

en: And it happened that when three hundred years had passed, both people of Nephi and the Lamanites became extremely wicked like one another.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin ałtso nááhaigo, tʼáá áła nephi bidineʼé dóó laman bidineʼé éí aheełtʼéego bąąhági átʼéii yaa ńdiikai.

en: And then when three hundred years had passed, both the people of Nephi and the Lamanites became very wicked like each other.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin ałtso nááhaigo, tʼáá áła nephi bidineʼé dóó laman bidineʼé éí aheełtʼéego bąąhági átʼéii yaa ńdiikai.

en: And it came to pass that when three hundred years had passed away, both the people of Nephi and the Lamanites had become exceedingly wicked one like unto another.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin ałtso nááhaigo, tʼáá áła nephi bidineʼé dóó laman bidineʼé éí aheełtʼéego bąąhági átʼéii yaa ńdiikai.

en: And it happened that after three hundred five years had passed, (and the people still remained in wickedness) Amos died; and his brother, Ammaron, kept the record in his stead.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan ashdlaʼ ałtso nááhaigo, (dóó tʼahdii diné bąąhági átʼéii yaa naakai) amos éí náádiilyá; dóó bikʼis, ammaron, amos bitsáskʼeh góneʼ béésh bikááʼ haneʼ ánáánéíłʼį́į́ ńtʼę́ę́ʼ.

en: And then after three hundred five years had passed (and the people stayed in wickedness) Amos died; and his brother, Ammaron, retained the record in his stead.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan ashdlaʼ ałtso nááhaigo, (dóó tʼahdii diné bąąhági átʼéii yaa naakai) amos éí náádiilyá; dóó bikʼis, ammaron, amos bitsáskʼeh góneʼ béésh bikááʼ haneʼ ánáánéíłʼį́į́ ńtʼę́ę́ʼ.

en: And it came to pass that after three hundred and five years had passed away, (and the people did still remain in wickedness) Amos died; and his brother, Ammaron, did keep the record in his stead.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan ashdlaʼ ałtso nááhaigo, (dóó tʼahdii diné bąąhági átʼéii yaa naakai) amos éí náádiilyá; dóó bikʼis, ammaron, amos bitsáskʼeh góneʼ béésh bikááʼ haneʼ ánáánéíłʼį́į́ ńtʼę́ę́ʼ.

en: And then in the three hundred sixty-fourth year the Lamanites came against the city of Teancum, that they may take possession of the city of Teancum, as well.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan hastą́diin dóó baʼaan dį́į́ʼgóó yihahgo laman bidineʼé kintah teancum yaatiih yíkai, áko teancum ałdóʼ shóideidoołtʼeeł biniiyé.

en: And it came to pass in the three hundred and sixty and fourth year the Lamanites did come against the city Teancum, that they might take possession of the city Teancum also.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan hastą́diin dóó baʼaan dį́į́ʼgóó yihahgo laman bidineʼé kintah teancum yaatiih yíkai, áko teancum ałdóʼ shóideidoołtʼeeł biniiyé.

en: And then the three hundred sixty-sixth year had passed, and the Lamanites returned to the Nephites to battle; and yet the Nephites didn’t repent of the evil they’d committed but continually persisted in their wickedness.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan hastą́diin dóó baʼaan hastą́ą́ ałtso nááhaigo, dóó laman bidineʼé éí nephi bidineʼé yaatiih náánákai; dóó ákondi áadi nephi bidineʼé doo yáʼátʼéehii yaa naakai yę́ę doo yóó adeidiʼaah da, ndi tʼóó tsé ádih bąąhági átʼéii yaa deíkááh.

en: And it came to pass that the three hundred and sixty and sixth year had passed away, and the Lamanites came again upon the Nephites to battle; and yet the Nephites repented not of the evil they had done, but persisted in their wickedness continually.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan hastą́diin dóó baʼaan hastą́ą́ ałtso nááhaigo, dóó laman bidineʼé éí nephi bidineʼé yaatiih náánákai; dóó ákondi áadi nephi bidineʼé doo yáʼátʼéehii yaa naakai yę́ę doo yóó adeidiʼaah da, ndi tʼóó tsé ádih bąąhági átʼéii yaa deíkááh.

en: And it happened that in the three hundred sixty-seventh year, the Nephites being angry because the Lamanites sacrificed their women and their children, that they went against the Lamanites with extremely great anger, so much that they beat the Lamanites again, and drive them from their lands.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan hastą́diin dóó baʼaan tsostsʼid yihahgo, éí nephi bidineʼé bá dahóóchįįd háálá laman bidineʼé badaʼáłchíní dóó bidaʼasdzą́ą́ ndeiłtseed dóó náádayiisniiʼgo biniinaa, áko tsʼídá bá dahóóchįįdgo laman bidineʼé yikʼijįʼ náádeeskai, dóó akʼehnáádadeesdlį́į́ʼ, dóó bikéyahdóó chʼínádeineeskaad.

en: And then in the three hundred sixty-seventh year, the Nephites being mad because the Lamanites sacrificed their women and their children that they went against the Lamanites with extreme fury, so much that they defeated the Lamanites again, and drive them out of their lands.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan hastą́diin dóó baʼaan tsostsʼid yihahgo, éí nephi bidineʼé bá dahóóchįįd háálá laman bidineʼé badaʼáłchíní dóó bidaʼasdzą́ą́ ndeiłtseed dóó náádayiisniiʼgo biniinaa, áko tsʼídá bá dahóóchįįdgo laman bidineʼé yikʼijįʼ náádeeskai, dóó akʼehnáádadeesdlį́į́ʼ, dóó bikéyahdóó chʼínádeineeskaad.

en: And it came to pass that in the three hundred and sixty and seventh year, the Nephites being angry because the Lamanites had sacrificed their women and their children, that they did go against the Lamanites with exceedingly great anger, insomuch that they did beat again the Lamanites, and drive them out of their lands.
nv: áádóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan hastą́diin dóó baʼaan tsostsʼid yihahgo, éí nephi bidineʼé bá dahóóchįįd háálá laman bidineʼé badaʼáłchíní dóó bidaʼasdzą́ą́ ndeiłtseed dóó náádayiisniiʼgo biniinaa, áko tsʼídá bá dahóóchįįdgo laman bidineʼé yikʼijįʼ náádeeskai, dóó akʼehnáádadeesdlį́į́ʼ, dóó bikéyahdóó chʼínádeineeskaad.

en: And then when three hundred twenty years had passed, Ammaron, being shackled by the Holy Ghost, hid the sacred records—yes, even all the sacred records that had been passed down generation to generation, which were sacred—even until the three hundred twentieth year after Christ’s coming.

nv: dóó ákótʼáo tʼáá nináháhááh bikʼehgo, tʼóó hózhǫ́ doo daʼoodlą́ą́góó dóó bąąhági átʼéii yaa ńdiikai, wónáásdóó naakidi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan tádiin ałtso nááhai ndi.

en: And thus they did dwindle in unbelief and wickedness, from year to year, even until two hundred and thirty years had passed away.
nv: dóó ákótʼáo tʼáá nináháhááh bikʼehgo, tʼóó hózhǫ́ doo daʼoodlą́ą́góó dóó bąąhági átʼéii yaa ńdiikai, wónáásdóó naakidi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan tádiin ałtso nááhai ndi.

en: And thus the ninety-second year passed, bringing great tidings to the people because of the signs which came to pass, according to the words of a prophecy of all the holy prophets.
nv: dóó ákótʼéego náhástʼédiin dóó baʼaan naaki ałtso nááhaigo, díí bee ééhózinii diyin god yá dahalneʼii náásgóó ádahodoonííł daanínę́ę éí bidaʼalyaago biniinaa, diné yaa bił dahóózhǫǫd.

en: And thus the ninety-second year did pass away, bringing glad tidings unto the people because of the signs which did come to pass, according to the words of the prophecy of all the holy prophets.
nv: dóó ákótʼéego náhástʼédiin dóó baʼaan naaki ałtso nááhaigo, díí bee ééhózinii diyin god yá dahalneʼii náásgóó ádahodoonííł daanínę́ę éí bidaʼalyaago biniinaa, diné yaa bił dahóózhǫǫd.

en: And king Benjamin opened his mouth again and began to speak to them, stating: My friends and my brothers, my kindred and my people, I’d call your attention again, that you may hear and understand the remainder of my words that I will tell you.
nv: dóó aláahdi naatʼáanii benjamin éí bizééʼ ąą ánááyiidlaa dóó yichʼįʼ hanáánáádzííʼ, kóníigo: shikʼisóó dóó shilahké, shikʼéí dóó shidineʼé danohłíinii, náádashíídóołtsʼįįł nisin, áko shizaad tʼáá yidziihígíí ałtso bee nihichʼįʼ hadeesdzih binahjįʼ dadidoohtsʼį́į́ł dóó bikʼidadiʼdoohtį́į́ł.

en: And king Benjamin again opened his mouth and began to speak unto them, saying: My friends and my brethren, my kindred and my people, I would again call your attention, that ye may hear and understand the remainder of my words which I shall speak unto you.
nv: dóó aláahdi naatʼáanii benjamin éí bizééʼ ąą ánááyiidlaa dóó yichʼįʼ hanáánáádzííʼ, kóníigo: shikʼisóó dóó shilahké, shikʼéí dóó shidineʼé danohłíinii, náádashíídóołtsʼįįł nisin, áko shizaad tʼáá yidziihígíí ałtso bee nihichʼįʼ hadeesdzih binahjįʼ dadidoohtsʼį́į́ł dóó bikʼidadiʼdoohtį́į́ł.

en: And it’s the faith that we’ve had on the things that our king has spoken to us that brought us to this great knowledge; whereby, we rejoice with such exceedingly great joy.
nv: dóó aláahdi nihinaatʼáanii yee haadzíʼígíí deiniidlą́ągo biniinaa díí ayóó átʼáo ééhózinii nihił béédahoozin, áko índa tʼáá íiyisíí nihił dahóózhǫǫd.

en: And it is the faith which we have had on the things which our king has spoken unto us that has brought us to this great knowledge, whereby we do rejoice with such exceedingly great joy.
nv: dóó aláahdi nihinaatʼáanii yee haadzíʼígíí deiniidlą́ągo biniinaa díí ayóó átʼáo ééhózinii nihił béédahoozin, áko índa tʼáá íiyisíí nihił dahóózhǫǫd.

en: And when the crowd had eaten and were filled, he said to the disciples: Behold there shall one be ordained among you, and to him will I give power that he will break bread and bless it and give it to the people of my church, to all those who will believe and be baptized in my name.
nv: dóó áłah jílínę́ę daʼiiyą́ą́ʼ dóó yee hwiih daazlį́įʼgo, akééʼ naazíinii kwíídííniid: jó nihitahdóó tʼááłáʼí bee deesįįł, dóó éí bááh yikʼi sońdílzįįh dóó ałtsʼánéítih dooleeł dóó shisodizin bá hooghan ńdeidiiláhígíí, dashoosdląądígíí dóó shízhiʼ binahjįʼ tó bee dadoolzį́łígíí, yaa neikaah dooleeł.

en: And when the multitude had eaten and were filled, he said unto the disciples: Behold there shall one be ordained among you, and to him will I give power that he shall break bread and bless it and give it unto the people of my church, unto all those who shall believe and be baptized in my name.
nv: dóó áłah jílínę́ę daʼiiyą́ą́ʼ dóó yee hwiih daazlį́įʼgo, akééʼ naazíinii kwíídííniid: jó nihitahdóó tʼááłáʼí bee deesįįł, dóó éí bááh yikʼi sońdílzįįh dóó ałtsʼánéítih dooleeł dóó shisodizin bá hooghan ńdeidiiláhígíí, dashoosdląądígíí dóó shízhiʼ binahjįʼ tó bee dadoolzį́łígíí, yaa neikaah dooleeł.

en: And also that they might thank the Lord their God, who’d brought them from the land of Jerusalem, and who’d delivered them from the hands of their enemies, and had appointed just men to be their teachers, and also a just man to be their king, who had established peace in the land of Zarahemla, and who taught them to keep the commandments of God, that they might rejoice and be filled with love towards God and all men.
nv: dóó ałdóʼ bóhólníihii bidiyin god, jerusalemdę́ę́ʼ chʼíbiníʼeezhígíí ahéheeʼ deididooniił, dóó beʼenaʼí danilínígíí yitsʼą́ą́dóó yisdádabííʼeezh, dóó diné tʼáá ákogi ádaatʼéii ndabinitin dooleełígíí yikʼidadiilniiʼ, dóó diné tʼáá ákogi átʼéii łaʼ aláahdi binaatʼáanii nilį́įgo ałdóʼ yikʼidadiilniiʼ, éí éiyá zarahemla hazʼą́ągi kʼé hólǫ́ǫgo áyiilaa, dóó diyin god bibeehazʼáanii yikʼeh dahółʼį́į doogo neineeztą́ą́ʼ, áko bił dahózhǫ́ǫ dooleeł dóó diyin god dóó diné tʼáá ałtso ayóo daʼahóʼníi dooleeł biniiyé.

en: And also that they might give thanks to the Lord their God, who had brought them out of the land of Jerusalem, and who had delivered them out of the hands of their enemies, and had appointed just men to be their teachers, and also a just man to be their king, who had established peace in the land of Zarahemla, and who had taught them to keep the commandments of God, that they might rejoice and be filled with love towards God and all men.
nv: dóó ałdóʼ bóhólníihii bidiyin god, jerusalemdę́ę́ʼ chʼíbiníʼeezhígíí ahéheeʼ deididooniił, dóó beʼenaʼí danilínígíí yitsʼą́ą́dóó yisdádabííʼeezh, dóó diné tʼáá ákogi ádaatʼéii ndabinitin dooleełígíí yikʼidadiilniiʼ, dóó diné tʼáá ákogi átʼéii łaʼ aláahdi binaatʼáanii nilį́įgo ałdóʼ yikʼidadiilniiʼ, éí éiyá zarahemla hazʼą́ągi kʼé hólǫ́ǫgo áyiilaa, dóó diyin god bibeehazʼáanii yikʼeh dahółʼį́į doogo neineeztą́ą́ʼ, áko bił dahózhǫ́ǫ dooleeł dóó diyin god dóó diné tʼáá ałtso ayóo daʼahóʼníi dooleeł biniiyé.

en: Neither did they receive any to baptism, save they came forth broken-hearted and of contrite spirit, and witnessed to the church they truly repented of all their sins.
nv: dóó ałdóʼ tsʼídá bąąhági ádáátʼįįdę́ę yaa yínííł danízinígíí, dóó sodizin bá hooghan yee daʼatahígíí yínááł beʼiinaʼ łahgo ánádayiidlaago tó yee deisį́į́h.

en: Neither did they receive any unto baptism save they came forth with a broken heart and a contrite spirit, and witnessed unto the church that they truly repented of all their sins.
nv: dóó ałdóʼ tsʼídá bąąhági ádáátʼįįdę́ę yaa yínííł danízinígíí, dóó sodizin bá hooghan yee daʼatahígíí yínááł beʼiinaʼ łahgo ánádayiidlaago tó yee deisį́į́h.

en: And if there were miracles wrought then, why’s God ceased to be the God of miracles and yet be an unchangeable Being?
nv: dóó álíleekʼehgo naanish ádaalyaago índa, haash yitʼáo éí diyin god kʼad doo álílee naalnish da dóó ákondi doo diné éí łahgo ánááʼníił da?

en: And if there were miracles wrought then, why has God ceased to be a God of miracles and yet be an unchangeable Being?
nv: dóó álíleekʼehgo naanish ádaalyaago índa, haash yitʼáo éí diyin god kʼad doo álílee naalnish da dóó ákondi doo diné éí łahgo ánááʼníił da?

en: And he told Alma: What does this mean that Amulek spoke concerning the resurrection of the dead, that all shall rise from the dead, both the just and the unjust, and are brought to stand before God to be judged according to their works?
nv: dóó alma iiłní: díí daneeznánígíí nááʼdiijeeh amulek yaa haadzíʼígíí haʼátʼíísh ááyiłní, éí tʼáá ałtso daneeznáádę́ę́ʼ náádidoojah, tʼáá ákogi dóó doo tʼáá ákogi ádaatʼéii tʼáá áła, dóó diyin god bidááhdóó nihidookah yindaashnishę́ę bikʼehgo bá ndahodootʼááł?

en: And he said unto Alma: What does this mean which Amulek hath spoken concerning the resurrection of the dead, that all shall rise from the dead, both the just and the unjust, and are brought to stand before God to be judged according to their works?
nv: dóó alma iiłní: díí daneeznánígíí nááʼdiijeeh amulek yaa haadzíʼígíí haʼátʼíísh ááyiłní, éí tʼáá ałtso daneeznáádę́ę́ʼ náádidoojah, tʼáá ákogi dóó doo tʼáá ákogi ádaatʼéii tʼáá áła, dóó diyin god bidááhdóó nihidookah yindaashnishę́ę bikʼehgo bá ndahodootʼááł?

en: And when he’d spoken to them, he turned himself to the three, and told them: What will you that I should do to you, when I am gone to the Father?
nv: dóó ałtso yichʼįʼ yáłtiʼgo, diné táltʼéhę́ę yichʼįʼ yiizįʼ, dóó kwíídííniid: nihíshąʼ éí ataaʼ bichʼįʼ anáásdzáá dóó bikʼijįʼ, haʼátʼíí bee nihíká adeeshwoł danohsin?

en: And when he had spoken unto them, he turned himself unto the three, and said unto them: What will ye that I should do unto you, when I am gone unto the Father?
nv: dóó ałtso yichʼįʼ yáłtiʼgo, diné táltʼéhę́ę yichʼįʼ yiizįʼ, dóó kwíídííniid: nihíshąʼ éí ataaʼ bichʼįʼ anáásdzáá dóó bikʼijįʼ, haʼátʼíí bee nihíká adeeshwoł danohsin?

en: And around the time that Ammaron hid up the records to the Lord, he came to me, (I being about ten years of age, and I began to be learned somewhat after a manner of the learning of my people) and Ammaron told me: I perceive that you’re a sober child, and are quick to observe;
nv: dóó ammaron béésh bikááʼ haneʼ bóhólníihii yichʼįʼ néideesʼį́į́ʼ yę́ędą́ą́ʼ, shaa níyá, (áko neeznáá shinááhaigo daatsʼí dóó shidineʼé tʼáadoo leʼé yídahoołʼą́ʼígíí éí bíhooshʼaahgo baa ńdiisdzá) dóó ammaron éí kóshidííniid: tʼahdii áłchíní nílį́įgo tʼáadoo leʼé honiyą́ągo bee naa ákonisin;

en: And about the time that Ammaron hid up the records unto the Lord, he came unto me, (I being about ten years of age, and I began to be learned somewhat after the manner of the learning of my people) and Ammaron said unto me: I perceive that thou art a sober child, and art quick to observe;
nv: dóó ammaron béésh bikááʼ haneʼ bóhólníihii yichʼįʼ néideesʼį́į́ʼ yę́ędą́ą́ʼ, shaa níyá, (áko neeznáá shinááhaigo daatsʼí dóó shidineʼé tʼáadoo leʼé yídahoołʼą́ʼígíí éí bíhooshʼaahgo baa ńdiisdzá) dóó ammaron éí kóshidííniid: tʼahdii áłchíní nílį́įgo tʼáadoo leʼé honiyą́ągo bee naa ákonisin;

en: And again I say to you, you must repent and be baptized in my name and become like a little child, or you can in nowise inherit the God’s kingdom.
nv: dóó ánáánihidishní, niheʼiinaʼ łahgo áńdaahdléhígíí, dóó shízhiʼ binahjįʼ tó bee danihiʼdilzį́į́h, dóó áłchínígi átʼéego ídaʼdołnééh, éí doodago díí ataaʼ bił hazʼą́ądi doo nihá hwiidooʼaał da.

en: And again I say unto you, ye must repent, and be baptized in my name, and become as a little child, or ye can in nowise inherit the kingdom of God.
nv: dóó ánáánihidishní, niheʼiinaʼ łahgo áńdaahdléhígíí, dóó shízhiʼ binahjįʼ tó bee danihiʼdilzį́į́h, dóó áłchínígi átʼéego ídaʼdołnééh, éí doodago díí ataaʼ bił hazʼą́ądi doo nihá hwiidooʼaał da.

en: And it shall come to pass that all lying, and deceiving, and envying, and strife, and priestcraft, and whoredom, shall be done away.
nv: dóó baa dahodoolzhish tʼáá ńtʼę́ę́ʼ yoochʼííd, dóó naʼadloʼ, dóó oolchʼį́į́d, dóó daʼahijigą́, béeso yikʼé sodadilzinígíí, dóó aláahdi joodláhígíí, ałtso ndahidootʼiʼ.

en: And it shall come to pass that all lyings, and deceivings, and envyings, and strifes, and priestcrafts, and whoredoms, shall be done away.
nv: dóó baa dahodoolzhish tʼáá ńtʼę́ę́ʼ yoochʼííd, dóó naʼadloʼ, dóó oolchʼį́į́d, dóó daʼahijigą́, béeso yikʼé sodadilzinígíí, dóó aláahdi joodláhígíí, ałtso ndahidootʼiʼ.

en: And when I desire to rejoice, my heart groans because of my sins; nevertheless, I know who I have trusted.
nv: dóó baa shił hózhǫ́ǫ doo nisingo, shijéí neezgai łeh, shibąąhági átʼéii biniinaa; ákótʼée ndi, baʼííníshłíhígíí éí shił bééhózin.

en: And when I desire to rejoice, my heart groaneth because of my sins; nevertheless, I know in whom I have trusted.
nv: dóó baa shił hózhǫ́ǫ doo nisingo, shijéí neezgai łeh, shibąąhági átʼéii biniinaa; ákótʼée ndi, baʼííníshłíhígíí éí shił bééhózin.

en: And they were strict to observe that there should be no iniquity among them; and whoever was found to commit iniquity, and three witnesses of the church condemned them before the elders, and if they didn’t repent, and didn’t confess, their names were blotted out, and they were not numbered among the people of Christ.
nv: dóó bąąhági átʼéii bitah dooleełígíí ayóó yaa daastiʼ, dóó háiida bąąhági ádzaago hádeilʼį́ʼígíí, dóó éí elder danilínígíí binááł sodizin bá hooghan yee dah deíkáhígíí táltʼéego daʼooʼínígíí yá ndahwiiʼaah ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, dóó doo beʼiinaʼ łahgo ánéídlééhgóó, dóó doo ádaa halneʼgóó, éí bízhiʼ nahjįʼ kódeileʼ, dóó doo éí christ dayoodlánígíí daʼatah da.

en: And they were strict to observe that there should be no iniquity among them; and whoso was found to commit iniquity, and three witnesses of the church did condemn them before the elders, and if they repented not, and confessed not, their names were blotted out, and they were not numbered among the people of Christ.
nv: dóó bąąhági átʼéii bitah dooleełígíí ayóó yaa daastiʼ, dóó háiida bąąhági ádzaago hádeilʼį́ʼígíí, dóó éí elder danilínígíí binááł sodizin bá hooghan yee dah deíkáhígíí táltʼéego daʼooʼínígíí yá ndahwiiʼaah ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, dóó doo beʼiinaʼ łahgo ánéídlééhgóó, dóó doo ádaa halneʼgóó, éí bízhiʼ nahjįʼ kódeileʼ, dóó doo éí christ dayoodlánígíí daʼatah da.

en: He’s not angry, vengeful, or retaliatory. His very purpose—His work and His glory—is to mentor to us, exalt us, and lead us into His fullness.
nv: doo báháchį’ da, doo atí’éł’į́į da, doo k’éédíshdlé nizin da. yiniiyé át’ínígíí éí—bi naanish dóó yee ayóó’át’éii—yee nanhintin, dego ánhilééh dóó yee át’éii yaa nihidoolóós.

en: He is not angry, vengeful, or retaliatory. His very purpose—His work and His glory—is to mentor us, exalt us, and lead us to His fulness.
nv: doo báháchį’ da, doo atí’éł’į́į da, doo k’éédíshdlé nizin da. yiniiyé át’ínígíí éí—bi naanish dóó yee ayóó’át’éii—yee nanhintin, dego ánhilééh dóó yee át’éii yaa nihidoolóós.

en: And a limnah of gold was the value of them all.
nv: dóó béésh óola limnah éí tʼáá ałtso ahidiiʼnilgo bą́ą́h ílį́.

en: And I saw his sword, and I drew it forth from its sheath; and its hilt was of pure gold, and its workmanship was exceedingly fine, and I saw its blade was of the most precious steel.
nv: dóó bibééshhał yiiłtsą́, dóó bizis biyiʼdóó háitą́; dóó bitsiin éí óola bee ályaa lá, dóó tsʼídá nizhónígo ałdóʼ ályaa lá, dóó hááhaashchiiʼjígo éí tsʼídá aláahdi béésh ílíinii ntłʼizígíí átʼéé lágo yiiłtsą́.

en: And I beheld his sword, and I drew it forth from the sheath thereof; and the hilt thereof was of pure gold, and the workmanship thereof was exceedingly fine, and I saw that the blade thereof was of the most precious steel.
nv: dóó bibééshhał yiiłtsą́, dóó bizis biyiʼdóó háitą́; dóó bitsiin éí óola bee ályaa lá, dóó tsʼídá nizhónígo ałdóʼ ályaa lá, dóó hááhaashchiiʼjígo éí tsʼídá aláahdi béésh ílíinii ntłʼizígíí átʼéé lágo yiiłtsą́.

en: And there were no gifts from the Lord, and the Holy Spirit didn’t come upon any, because of their wickedness and unbelief.
nv: dóó bóhólníihii éí doo akʼihojídlíi da silį́į́ʼ, dóó iiʼsizį́ diyinii éí tʼáá háiida doo bił hólǫ́ǫ da ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, háálá bąąhági átʼéii yaa naakaiígíí dóó doo daʼoodlánígíí biniinaa.

en: And there were no gifts from the Lord, and the Holy Ghost did not come upon any, because of their wickedness and unbelief.
nv: dóó bóhólníihii éí doo akʼihojídlíi da silį́į́ʼ, dóó iiʼsizį́ diyinii éí tʼáá háiida doo bił hólǫ́ǫ da ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, háálá bąąhági átʼéii yaa naakaiígíí dóó doo daʼoodlánígíí biniinaa.

en: And Christ had said: If you will have faith in me you shall have power to do whatever thing is expedient in me.
nv: dóó christ ání: dashiinohdlą́ągo éí tʼáá ałtsoní nihá yáʼátʼééh nisinígíí ádadoohłííł.

en: And Christ hath said: If ye will have faith in me ye shall have power to do whatsoever thing is expedient in me.
nv: dóó christ ání: dashiinohdlą́ągo éí tʼáá ałtsoní nihá yáʼátʼééh nisinígíí ádadoohłííł.

en: And if you’ll believe in Christ you’ll believe in these words, for they’re the words of Christ, and he has given them to me; and they teach all men that they should do good.
nv: dóó christ deinohdlą́ągo díí saad deidoohdląął, háálá éí christ bizaad átʼé, dóó éí éiyá sheinílá; dóó éí diné tʼáá ałtso yáʼátʼéehgo naʼadájí yee neinitin.

en: And if ye shall believe in Christ ye will believe in these words, for they are the words of Christ, and he hath given them unto me; and they teach all men that they should do good.
nv: dóó christ deinohdlą́ągo díí saad deidoohdląął, háálá éí christ bizaad átʼé, dóó éí éiyá sheinílá; dóó éí diné tʼáá ałtso yáʼátʼéehgo naʼadájí yee neinitin.

nv: dóó índa kótʼéego hodidootsʼį́į́ł: bitsʼánóhkááh, bitsʼánóhkááh, áádę́ę́ʼ yíwohjįʼ, bąąhági ádaatʼéii tʼáadoo ndaahjaahí; binííʼdóó chʼínóhkááh; chin nihąąh ádingo ídaʼdółnééh bóhólníihii binaalyéii dah danohłéii.

en: And then a cry will go out: Depart, depart, go out from there, do not touch that which is unclean; go out of the midst of her; be clean that bear the vessels of the Lord.
nv: dóó índa kótʼéego hodidootsʼį́į́ł: bitsʼánóhkááh, bitsʼánóhkááh, áádę́ę́ʼ yíwohjįʼ, bąąhági ádaatʼéii tʼáadoo ndaahjaahí; binííʼdóó chʼínóhkááh; chin nihąąh ádingo ídaʼdółnééh bóhólníihii binaalyéii dah danohłéii.

en: And then you will immerse them in the water, and come back out of the water again.
nv: dóó índa tó bił didoołkǫǫł, dóó táyiʼdę́ę́ʼ háá doołtʼeeł.

en: And then you’ll immerse them within the water, and come again out of the water.
nv: dóó índa tó bił didoołkǫǫł, dóó táyiʼdę́ę́ʼ háá doołtʼeeł.

en: And then shall ye immerse them in the water, and come forth again out of the water.
nv: dóó índa tó bił didoołkǫǫł, dóó táyiʼdę́ę́ʼ háá doołtʼeeł.

en: And it didn’t matter to me that I’m particular to give full account of all my father’s things, for they can’t be written on these plates, for I desire the room that I may write of God’s things.
nv: dóó índa tʼáá ałtso shizhéʼé baa haneʼ nááháasdzooígíí doo alą́ąjįʼ baa ntséskees da, háálá eii díí béésh óola tʼą́hí bikááʼ nááhídóodzohgo doo bóhóoghah da, háálá tʼáá bikááʼ hazʼánígi éí diyin god bídéétʼiʼígíí bee akʼiʼdeeshchííł nisin.

en: And it mattereth not to me that I am particular to give a full account of all the things of my father, for they cannot be written upon these plates, for I desire the room that I may write of the things of God.
nv: dóó índa tʼáá ałtso shizhéʼé baa haneʼ nááháasdzooígíí doo alą́ąjįʼ baa ntséskees da, háálá eii díí béésh óola tʼą́hí bikááʼ nááhídóodzohgo doo bóhóoghah da, háálá tʼáá bikááʼ hazʼánígi éí diyin god bídéétʼiʼígíí bee akʼiʼdeeshchííł nisin.

en: And after they’d given thanks to the God of Israel, my father, Lehi, took the records that were engraved upon the plates of brass, and he searched them from the beginning.
nv: dóó israel bidiyin god yichʼįʼ ahéheeʼ dadííniidgo índa, shizhéʼé, lehi, béésh łitsoii bikááʼ naʼasdzo yę́ę néidiiʼą́, dóó hahoolzhiizh dóó wóshdę́ę́ʼ haʼííłtaʼ.

en: And after they had given thanks unto the God of Israel, my father, Lehi, took the records which were engraven upon the plates of brass, and he did search them from the beginning.
nv: dóó israel bidiyin god yichʼįʼ ahéheeʼ dadííniidgo índa, shizhéʼé, lehi, béésh łitsoii bikááʼ naʼasdzo yę́ę néidiiʼą́, dóó hahoolzhiizh dóó wóshdę́ę́ʼ haʼííłtaʼ.

en: And Jacob and Joseph also, being young, having need of much nourishment, were grieved because of the afflictions of their mother; and also amy wife with her tears and prayers, and also my children, did not soften the hearts of my brethren that they would loose me.
nv: dóó jacob dóó joseph ałdóʼ, tʼahdii awééʼ nilį́įgo biniinaa, dichin nízingo, bimá tiʼhooníihgo yaa yínííł niizį́į́ʼ; dóó sheʼesdzáán, dóó shaʼáłchíní ałdóʼ, sodazdilzin dóó dajichago, kʼenáʼóʼaad chʼééh dajiníigo shaa bee ńdaʼjookąąh ákondi doo éí shikʼisóó bidééłníi da.

en: And when they’d ministered those same words Jesus had spoken—nothing varying from the words Jesus had spoken—behold, they knelt again and prayed to the Father in Jesus’ name.
nv: dóó jesus yínaʼneestą́ʼą́ą tsʼídá kótʼéego yínadaʼneestą́ą́ʼ—tsʼídá tʼáadoo łahgo átʼéhé jesus yínaʼneestą́ʼą́ą yíndaʼniłtin—jó, ntsináádadeesgoʼ dóó jesus bízhiʼ binahjįʼ ataaʼ yichʼįʼ sonáádadilzin.

en: And when they had ministered those same words which Jesus had spoken—nothing varying from the words which Jesus had spoken—behold, they knelt again and prayed to the Father in the name of Jesus.
nv: dóó jesus yínaʼneestą́ʼą́ą tsʼídá kótʼéego yínadaʼneestą́ą́ʼ—tsʼídá tʼáadoo łahgo átʼéhé jesus yínaʼneestą́ʼą́ą yíndaʼniłtin—jó, ntsináádadeesgoʼ dóó jesus bízhiʼ binahjįʼ ataaʼ yichʼįʼ sonáádadilzin.

en: And by so doing, the Lord God prepared the way that the residue of men may have faith in Christ, that the Holy Spirit may have a place in their hearts, according to the power thereof; and after this manner brought to pass the Father, the covenants he had made to the children of men.
nv: dóó kódáátʼį́įgo, bóhólníihii diyin god diné chʼéédzíʼígíí christ dayoodlą́ą doogo yá hashtʼedahalééh áko iiʼsizį́ diyinii bibee adziilii bee bijéí biiʼ dahólǫ́ǫ doo; kótʼéego ataaʼ bílaʼashdlaʼii baʼáłchíní yił ahadaʼdeetʼánę́ę ałtso yidaʼaleʼ.

en: And by so doing, the Lord God prepareth the way that the residue of men may have faith in Christ, that the Holy Ghost may have place in their hearts, according to the power thereof; and after this manner bringeth to pass the Father, the covenants which he hath made unto the children of men.
nv: dóó kódáátʼį́įgo, bóhólníihii diyin god diné chʼéédzíʼígíí christ dayoodlą́ą doogo yá hashtʼedahalééh áko iiʼsizį́ diyinii bibee adziilii bee bijéí biiʼ dahólǫ́ǫ doo; kótʼéego ataaʼ bílaʼashdlaʼii baʼáłchíní yił ahadaʼdeetʼánę́ę ałtso yidaʼaleʼ.

en: And he spoke to them, saying: Behold, my sons and my daughters, who are the sons and the daughters of my second son; behold I leave you the same blessing I left to the sons and daughters of Laman; why, you shall not be completely destroyed; but in the end your seed will be blessed.
nv: dóó kóníigo, yichʼįʼ yááłtiʼ: jó, shitsóóké dóó shinálíké danohłíinii shiyeʼ naaki góneʼ naagháhígíí biyeʼ dóó bitsiʼ danohłíinii; jó laman biyeʼ dóó bitsiʼ sodizin bee bá haasdzííʼ yę́ę nihídóʼ nihaa nishłé; ákohgo, doo éí ałtso nanihiʼdooltsił da; háálá nihoolzhiizhdi nihaʼáłchíní dooleełígíí bikʼidahojidoodliił.

en: And he spake unto them, saying: Behold, my sons and my daughters, who are the sons and the daughters of my second son; behold I leave unto you the same blessing which I left unto the sons and daughters of Laman; wherefore, thou shalt not utterly be destroyed; but in the end thy seed shall be blessed.
nv: dóó kóníigo, yichʼįʼ yááłtiʼ: jó, shitsóóké dóó shinálíké danohłíinii shiyeʼ naaki góneʼ naagháhígíí biyeʼ dóó bitsiʼ danohłíinii; jó laman biyeʼ dóó bitsiʼ sodizin bee bá haasdzííʼ yę́ę nihídóʼ nihaa nishłé; ákohgo, doo éí ałtso nanihiʼdooltsił da; háálá nihoolzhiizhdi nihaʼáłchíní dooleełígíí bikʼidahojidoodliił.

en: And thus did the thirty-eighth year pass away, and also the thirty-ninth, and forty-first, and the forty-second, yea, even until forty-nine years had passed away, and also the fifty-first, and the fifty-second; yea, and even until fifty-nine years had passed away.
nv: dóó kótʼáo tádiin dóó baʼaan tseebíí ałtso nááhai, dóó tádiin dóó baʼaan náhástʼéí ałdóʼ ałtso nááhai; dóó dízdiin dóó baʼaan tʼááłáʼí, dóó dízdiin dóó baʼaan naaki ałtso nááhai; aooʼ, ńléí dízdiin dóó baʼaan náhástʼéijįʼ ałtso nááhai ndi, dóó ałdóʼ ashdladiin dóó baʼaan tʼááłáʼí éí ałtso nááhai, dóó ashdladiin dóó baʼaan naaki ałtso nááhai; aooʼ, ńléí ashdladiin dóó baʼaan náhástʼéijįʼ ałtso nááhai ndi.

en: And thus did the thirty and eighth year pass away, and also the thirty and ninth, and forty and first, and the forty and second, yea, even until forty and nine years had passed away, and also the fifty and first, and the fifty and second; yea, and even until fifty and nine years had passed away.
nv: dóó kótʼáo tádiin dóó baʼaan tseebíí ałtso nááhai, dóó tádiin dóó baʼaan náhástʼéí ałdóʼ ałtso nááhai; dóó dízdiin dóó baʼaan tʼááłáʼí, dóó dízdiin dóó baʼaan naaki ałtso nááhai; aooʼ, ńléí dízdiin dóó baʼaan náhástʼéijįʼ ałtso nááhai ndi, dóó ałdóʼ ashdladiin dóó baʼaan tʼááłáʼí éí ałtso nááhai, dóó ashdladiin dóó baʼaan naaki ałtso nááhai; aooʼ, ńléí ashdladiin dóó baʼaan náhástʼéijįʼ ałtso nááhai ndi.

en: And after that you were blessed then the Father fulfilled the covenant he made with Abraham, saying: In your offspring all the kindreds of the earth will be blessed—to the pouring out of the Holy Ghost through me on the Gentiles, which upon the Gentiles blessing will make them mighty above all, to the scattering of my people, oh house of Israel.
nv: dóó kótʼéego nihikʼihojisdliʼgo áko ataaʼ kóníigo abraham yił ałhaʼdeetʼánę́ę: nihikʼǫ́ǫ́ʼ binahjįʼ éí nihookááʼ dineʼé bikʼidahojídlíi dooleeł, nínę́ę biʼdoolnííł—iiʼsizį́ diyinii éí gentile dineʼé bee bikʼijideeshdliił, díí gentile dineʼé bikʼihojisdliʼgo tsʼídá aláahdi ábóodziil dooleeł, kótʼéego shidineʼé baa taidoojah, o israel bighandóó danilíinii.

en: And after that ye were blessed then fulfilleth the Father the covenant which he made with Abraham, saying: In thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed—unto the pouring out of the Holy Ghost through me upon the Gentiles, which blessing upon the Gentiles shall make them mighty above all, unto the scattering of my people, O house of Israel.
nv: dóó kótʼéego nihikʼihojisdliʼgo áko ataaʼ kóníigo abraham yił ałhaʼdeetʼánę́ę: nihikʼǫ́ǫ́ʼ binahjįʼ éí nihookááʼ dineʼé bikʼidahojídlíi dooleeł, nínę́ę biʼdoolnííł—iiʼsizį́ diyinii éí gentile dineʼé bee bikʼijideeshdliił, díí gentile dineʼé bikʼihojisdliʼgo tsʼídá aláahdi ábóodziil dooleeł, kótʼéego shidineʼé baa taidoojah, o israel bighandóó danilíinii.

en: And now I’d suggest you might know, that after my father, Lehi, had made the end of prophesying concerning his offspring, it came to pass that the Lord spoke to him again, saying it wasn’t meet for him, Lehi, that he should take his family into the wilderness alone; but his sons should take daughters as wives, that they might raise offspring to the Lord in the promised land.
nv: dóó kʼad díí nihił bééhózin doo nisin, shizhéʼé, lehi, ałtso náásgóó baʼáłchíní danilį́į dooleełígíí yaa yááłtiʼgo, áádóó bóhólníihii bichʼįʼ hanáánáádzííʼ: lehi, baʼáłchíní dóó beʼesdzáán doo tʼáá sáhí doo kééhatʼínígi dah yididooʼish da níílá; ndi beʼashiiké éí náánáłahdę́ę́ʼ atsiʼ danilínígíí bichʼooní ádeidoolííł, áko kéyah bee ahaʼdeetʼánídi baʼáłchíní bóhólníihii deidoodląąłgo deidínóosééł.

en: And now I would that ye might know, that after my father, Lehi, had made an end of prophesying concerning his seed, it came to pass that the Lord spake unto him again, saying that it was not meet for him, Lehi, that he should take his family into the wilderness alone; but that his sons should take daughters to wife, that they might raise up seed unto the Lord in the land of promise.
nv: dóó kʼad díí nihił bééhózin doo nisin, shizhéʼé, lehi, ałtso náásgóó baʼáłchíní danilį́į dooleełígíí yaa yááłtiʼgo, áádóó bóhólníihii bichʼįʼ hanáánáádzííʼ: lehi, baʼáłchíní dóó beʼesdzáán doo tʼáá sáhí doo kééhatʼínígi dah yididooʼish da níílá; ndi beʼashiiké éí náánáłahdę́ę́ʼ atsiʼ danilínígíí bichʼooní ádeidoolííł, áko kéyah bee ahaʼdeetʼánídi baʼáłchíní bóhólníihii deidoodląąłgo deidínóosééł.

en: And now behold, this was the desire I wished of him—that if it should be so, that my people, the Nephites, should fall into transgression, and by any means be destroyed, and the Lamanites shouldn’t be destroyed, that the Lord God would preserve record of my people, the Nephites; even if it’s by the power of his holy arm, that it might be brought forth at some day in the future to the Lamanites, that, perhaps, they might be brought to salvation—
nv: dóó kʼad jó, áko kʼad bitsʼą́ą́dę́ę́ʼ nisinę́ę éi díí—ákó shidineʼé, nephi bidineʼé haitʼáo da ndaʼiisíihgo, dóó éí biniinaa da ndabiʼdistseedgo, dóó laman bidineʼé éí doo ndabidiʼdootsił da, bóhólníihii diyin god shidineʼé, nephi bidineʼé bahaneʼ hashtʼeneidooʼááł; bigaan diyingo bibee adziilii da bee, áko háadi da náás yiską́ądi laman bidineʼé baa dootʼááł, áko yee daatsʼí yisdáńdookah biniiyé—

en: And now behold, this was the desire which I desired of him—that if it should so be, that my people, the Nephites, should fall into transgression, and by any means be destroyed, and the Lamanites should not be destroyed, that the Lord God would preserve a record of my people, the Nephites; even if it so be by the power of his holy arm, that it might be brought forth at some future day unto the Lamanites, that, perhaps, they might be brought unto salvation—
nv: dóó kʼad jó, áko kʼad bitsʼą́ą́dę́ę́ʼ nisinę́ę éi díí—ákó shidineʼé, nephi bidineʼé haitʼáo da ndaʼiisíihgo, dóó éí biniinaa da ndabiʼdistseedgo, dóó laman bidineʼé éí doo ndabidiʼdootsił da, bóhólníihii diyin god shidineʼé, nephi bidineʼé bahaneʼ hashtʼeneidooʼááł; bigaan diyingo bibee adziilii da bee, áko háadi da náás yiską́ądi laman bidineʼé baa dootʼááł, áko yee daatsʼí yisdáńdookah biniiyé—

en: And now I, Mormon, would that you should know that the people had multiplied, insomuch that they were spread acreoss all the face of the land, and that they’d become exceedingly rich, because of their prosperity in Christ.
nv: dóó kʼad shí, mormon, díí nihił béédahodoozįįł nisin diné éí ałʼąą dínéestʼą́, áko índa tʼáá ałtsogóó nihookááʼgóó daazlį́į́ʼ, dóó christ bikʼihojídlíigo biniinaa, diné ayóó átʼéego daʼatʼį́ silį́į́ʼ.

en: And now I, Mormon, would that ye should know that the people had multiplied, insomuch that they were spread upon all the face of the land, and that they had become exceedingly rich, because of their prosperity in Christ.
nv: dóó kʼad shí, mormon, díí nihił béédahodoozįįł nisin diné éí ałʼąą dínéestʼą́, áko índa tʼáá ałtsogóó nihookááʼgóó daazlį́į́ʼ, dóó christ bikʼihojídlíigo biniinaa, diné ayóó átʼéego daʼatʼį́ silį́į́ʼ.

en: And now I, Nephi, can’t say more; the Spirit stopped my utterance, and I’m left to mourn because of the unbelief, and the wickedness, and the ignorance, and men’s stiffneckedness; for they won’t seek knowledge, nor understand great knowledge, when it’s given to them in plainness, even as plain as words can be.
nv: dóó kʼad shí, nephi, tʼáá ákódígo bee hadeesdzih, háálá iiʼsizíinii éí nashiníłtłʼah; éí biniinaa tʼóó yínííł nisin, háálá nihookááʼ dineʼé éí tsʼídá doo daʼoodlą́ą da, dóó bąąhági átʼéii tʼéiyá yaa naakai, dóó tsʼídá doo bił éédahózin da, dóó bikʼos daniłdzil; tsʼídá saad doo nanitłʼahgóó bee nanishtingo ndi, doo yikʼidaʼdiitįįh da, dóó doo ndeiłkaah da.

en: And now I, Nephi, cannot say more; the Spirit stoppeth mine utterance, and I am left to mourn because of the unbelief, and the wickedness, and the ignorance, and the stiffneckedness of men; for they will not search knowledge, nor understand great knowledge, when it is given unto them in plainness, even as plain as word can be.
nv: dóó kʼad shí, nephi, tʼáá ákódígo bee hadeesdzih, háálá iiʼsizíinii éí nashiníłtłʼah; éí biniinaa tʼóó yínííł nisin, háálá nihookááʼ dineʼé éí tsʼídá doo daʼoodlą́ą da, dóó bąąhági átʼéii tʼéiyá yaa naakai, dóó tsʼídá doo bił éédahózin da, dóó bikʼos daniłdzil; tsʼídá saad doo nanitłʼahgóó bee nanishtingo ndi, doo yikʼidaʼdiitįįh da, dóó doo ndeiłkaah da.

en: And now my brothers, I judge these things of you because of your peaceful walk with the children of men.
nv: dóó kʼad shikʼisóó danohłíinii, shí éí kótʼéego bee nihiníshʼį́ háálá kʼé bikʼehgo éí bílaʼashdlaʼii baʼáłchíní bitaahłdeeh.

en: And now my brethren, I judge these things of you because of your peaceable walk with the children of men.
nv: dóó kʼad shikʼisóó danohłíinii, shí éí kótʼéego bee nihiníshʼį́ háálá kʼé bikʼehgo éí bílaʼashdlaʼii baʼáłchíní bitaahłdeeh.

en: And now Father, I apray unto thee for them, and also for all those who shall believe on their words, that they may believe in me, that I may be in them bas thou, Father, art in me, that we may be cone.
nv: dóó kʼad shitaaʼ, bá nichʼįʼ sodiszin, dóó tʼáá ałtso bizaad daʼiidoodląąłígíí ałdóʼ, áko dashiidoodląął, áko biiʼ honishłǫ́ǫ doo, nígi átʼáo, shitaaʼ, shiiʼ honílǫ́ átʼéego, áko tʼááłáʼí niidlį́į doo.

en: And now, it happened that Alma, who had fled from the servants of king Noah, repented of his sins and iniquities and went out privately among the people and began teaching the words of Abinadi—
nv: dóó kʼad, áádóó alma, aláahdi naatʼáanii noah bá ndaalteʼé yílákʼee haalwodę́ę, bąąhági ádaatʼéii dóó tʼóó baaʼihii bee bá ndeetʼą́ągo beʼiinaʼ łahgo áyiilaa, dóó nanitingo diné yitaaghá, dóó abinadi yee haadzíʼę́ę yee naʼdíʼníítą́ą́ʼ—

en: And now, it came to pass that Alma, who had fled from the servants of king Noah, repented of his sins and iniquities, and went about privately among the people, and began to teach the words of Abinadi—
nv: dóó kʼad, áádóó alma, aláahdi naatʼáanii noah bá ndaalteʼé yílákʼee haalwodę́ę, bąąhági ádaatʼéii dóó tʼóó baaʼihii bee bá ndeetʼą́ągo beʼiinaʼ łahgo áyiilaa, dóó nanitingo diné yitaaghá, dóó abinadi yee haadzíʼę́ę yee naʼdíʼníítą́ą́ʼ—

en: And now, if the Lamb of God, being holy, should’ve needed to be baptized by water, to fulfill all righteousness, Oh then, how much more do we need to have, being unholy, to be baptized, yes, even by water!
nv: dóó kʼad, diyin god bidibé yázhí jílíinii, diyin nilį́į ndi, tó bee bidiʼdoolzį́į́ł, bee hazʼánígíí hólǫ́ǫgo yáʼátʼéehii biniinaa yiʼdoolíiłii, o índa, nihí, doo dadiniiyinígíí biniinaa, tʼáá íiyisíí tó bee nihidiʼdoolzį́į́ł nidzin, aooʼ, tó bee ndi!

en: And now, if the Lamb of God, he being holy, should have need to be baptized by water, to fulfil all righteousness, O then, how much more need have we, being unholy, to be baptized, yea, even by water!

en: And now, my beloved brethren, all those who are of the house of Israel, and all ye ends of the earth, I speak unto you as the voice of one crying from the dust: Farewell until that great day shall come.

en: And now, my brothers, seeing that we know these things and that they are true, let’s repent and not harden our hearts, that we not provoke the Lord our God to lay down his wrath on us in these his second commandments he has given to us; but let’s enter into the rest of God, that is prepared according to his word.

en: And now, my brethren, seeing we know these things, and they are true, let us repent, and harden not our hearts, that we provoke not the Lord our God to pull down his wrath upon us in these his second commandments which he has given unto us; but let us enter into the rest of God, which is prepared according to his word.
