en: And again I tell you as I’ve said before that as you’ve come to the knowledge of God’s glory, or if you’ve known of his goodness and have tasted of his love and have received remission of your sins, which caused such exceedingly great joy in your souls, even so I’d suggest that you should remember, and always remember the greatness of God and your own nothingness and his goodness and long-suffering towards you, unworthy creatures, and humble yourselves even in the depths of humility, calling on the Lord’s name daily, and standing steadfastly in the faith of that which is to come, which was spoken by the angel’s mouth.
nv: dóó nááná ánihidííniidgo átʼáo ánáánihidishní, éí diyin god beʼayóó átʼéii baa ákodanoozį́įʼgo, éí doodago biyáʼátʼéehii baa ákonoozį́įʼgo dóó beʼayóó óʼóʼníinii nihił ádzaago, dóó nihibąąhági ádaatʼéii bee nihaa nídaʼdeestʼą́ągo, binahjįʼ tʼáá íiyisíí ił hózhóonii nihitsʼíís dóó nihiyiʼsizíinii biyiʼ silį́į́ʼ, ákótʼée ndi díí éí béédaohłniih dooleeł nisin, dóó tʼáá áłahjįʼ éí béédaohłniih dooleeł, diyin god éí beʼaláahdi átʼéii, dóó nihí éí doo ndi danohłíní da, dóó biyáʼátʼéehii dóó nízaadgo nihąąh tiʼhooʼníhígíí, doo danohłíinii, dóó tʼáá íiyisíí nihaa hojoobaʼígo ádaʼdołnééh, tʼáá ákwííjį́ bóhólníihii bichʼįʼ sodadołzingo, dóó áhodooníłígíí deinohdlą́ągo bee ndasoozį́įgo, éí diyin yá naalʼaʼí yee haadzíʼę́ę átʼé.

en: And again I say unto you as I have said before, that as ye have come to the knowledge of the glory of God, or if ye have known of his goodness and have tasted of his love, and have received a remission of your sins, which causeth such exceedingly great joy in your souls, even so I would that ye should remember, and always retain in remembrance, the greatness of God, and your own nothingness, and his goodness and long-suffering towards you, unworthy creatures, and humble yourselves even in the depths of humility, calling on the name of the Lord daily, and standing steadfastly in the faith of that which is to come, which was spoken by the mouth of the angel.
nv: dóó nááná ánihidííniidgo átʼáo ánáánihidishní, éí diyin god beʼayóó átʼéii baa ákodanoozį́įʼgo, éí doodago biyáʼátʼéehii baa ákonoozį́įʼgo dóó beʼayóó óʼóʼníinii nihił ádzaago, dóó nihibąąhági ádaatʼéii bee nihaa nídaʼdeestʼą́ągo, binahjįʼ tʼáá íiyisíí ił hózhóonii nihitsʼíís dóó nihiyiʼsizíinii biyiʼ silį́į́ʼ, ákótʼée ndi díí éí béédaohłniih dooleeł nisin, dóó tʼáá áłahjįʼ éí béédaohłniih dooleeł, diyin god éí beʼaláahdi átʼéii, dóó nihí éí doo ndi danohłíní da, dóó biyáʼátʼéehii dóó nízaadgo nihąąh tiʼhooʼníhígíí, doo danohłíinii, dóó tʼáá íiyisíí nihaa hojoobaʼígo ádaʼdołnééh, tʼáá ákwííjį́ bóhólníihii bichʼįʼ sodadołzingo, dóó áhodooníłígíí deinohdlą́ągo bee ndasoozį́įgo, éí diyin yá naalʼaʼí yee haadzíʼę́ę átʼé.

en: And again, the Lord called the others, and told them likewise; and he gave them power to baptize.
nv: dóó nááná bóhólníihii łaʼ wóshdę́ę́ʼ náánéidooʼniid, dóó kótʼéego yichʼįʼ hanáánáádzííʼ; dóó tó bee alzį́į́hjígo adziilii yaa yizlá.

en: And again the Lord called others, and said unto them likewise; and he gave unto them power to baptize.
nv: dóó nááná bóhólníihii łaʼ wóshdę́ę́ʼ náánéidooʼniid, dóó kótʼéego yichʼįʼ hanáánáádzííʼ; dóó tó bee alzį́į́hjígo adziilii yaa yizlá.

en: And again the third time they heard the voice and opened their ears to hear it; and their eyes were toward the sound thereof; and they looked steadfastly towards heaven, from where the sound came.
nv: dóó nááná tááʼ góneʼ hanááʼoodzíiʼgo índa iinééʼ dazhdiiztsʼą́ą́ʼ, dóó deididootsʼį́į́ł biniiyé bijaaʼ ąą ádayiilaa; dóó hodiitsʼaʼígíí yichʼįʼ dadéeʼį́į́ʼ, dóó yáʼąąsh gódei, doo nahjįʼ kódaanééhgóó hodiiztsʼą́ą́ʼjígo dadéeʼį́į́ʼ.

en: And again the third time they did hear the voice, and did open their ears to hear it; and their eyes were towards the sound thereof; and they did look steadfastly towards heaven, from whence the sound came.
nv: dóó nááná tááʼ góneʼ hanááʼoodzíiʼgo índa iinééʼ dazhdiiztsʼą́ą́ʼ, dóó deididootsʼį́į́ł biniiyé bijaaʼ ąą ádayiilaa; dóó hodiitsʼaʼígíí yichʼįʼ dadéeʼį́į́ʼ, dóó yáʼąąsh gódei, doo nahjįʼ kódaanééhgóó hodiiztsʼą́ą́ʼjígo dadéeʼį́į́ʼ.

en: And again, so much as parents have kids in Zion, or in any of her stakes that are organized, that teach them to not comprehend the doctrine of repentance, faith in Christ the Son of the living God, and of the baptism and the gift of the Holy Spirit by the laying of the hands, when eight years old, the sin will be upon the heads of the parents.
nv: dóó naaná, azheʼé dóó amá ziongi baʼáłchíní holǫ́ǫgo, éí doodaó sodizin bahoghan naazniljí bił hoo dzohjí biyi éí diyin bisodizin báhooghan hashtʼéʼ ádalyaa, báʼáłchíni tseebíí bináághaigo díí dashijaaʼígíí, iinaʼ łahgo ánálnéeh dóó diyin god hiináago biyeʼ jesus christ woodlánigíí dóó toʼ bee ałzį́́į́h, dóó atsiitʼááh dahʼadéesniigo níłchʼi diyinii iiʼsizíinii aa yílyéii, doo yee neeneestą́ą́ʼgó éí bááhági átʼéii, amá dóó azheʼé tʼááʼ áłah bikʼijį siʼą́ą dooleeł.

en: And again, inasmuch as parents have children in Zion, or in any of her stakes which are organized, that teach them not to understand the doctrine of repentance, faith in Christ the Son of the living God, and of baptism and the gift of the Holy Ghost by the laying on of the hands, when eight years old, the sin be upon the heads of the parents.
nv: dóó naaná, azheʼé dóó amá ziongi baʼáłchíní holǫ́ǫgo, éí doodaó sodizin bahoghan naazniljí bił hoo dzohjí biyi éí diyin bisodizin báhooghan hashtʼéʼ ádalyaa, báʼáłchíni tseebíí bináághaigo díí dashijaaʼígíí, iinaʼ łahgo ánálnéeh dóó diyin god hiináago biyeʼ jesus christ woodlánigíí dóó toʼ bee ałzį́́į́h, dóó atsiitʼááh dahʼadéesniigo níłchʼi diyinii iiʼsizíinii aa yílyéii, doo yee neeneestą́ą́ʼgó éí bááhági átʼéii, amá dóó azheʼé tʼááʼ áłah bikʼijį siʼą́ą dooleeł.

en: And again, to another, that he may work mighty miracles;
nv: dóó nááná, łaʼígíí éí bichʼįʼ, ayóó álílee ayóó ádaatʼéhígíí ííłʼį́į dooleeł;

en: And again, there was another church that denied the Christ; and they persecuted the true church of Christ, because of their humility and their belief in Christ; and they despised them because of the many miracles that were wrought among them.
nv: dóó nááná, náánáłaʼ sodizin bá hooghan léiʼ christ doo deiniidlą́ą da daaní; áádóó tʼáá aaníí christ bisodizin bá hooghanę́ę dayoołchʼį́į́d, háálá éí diné hojoobaʼ ádeinízingo dóó christ dayoodlą́ągo biniinaa; dóó deijoosłááʼ háálá ląʼída éí bitahgóó álílee diyinkʼehgo naʼanish ádaalyaahą́ą biniinaa.

en: And again, there was another church which denied the Christ; and they did persecute the true church of Christ, because of their humility and their belief in Christ; and they did despise them because of the many miracles which were wrought among them.
nv: dóó nááná, náánáłaʼ sodizin bá hooghan léiʼ christ doo deiniidlą́ą da daaní; áádóó tʼáá aaníí christ bisodizin bá hooghanę́ę dayoołchʼį́į́d, háálá éí diné hojoobaʼ ádeinízingo dóó christ dayoodlą́ągo biniinaa; dóó deijoosłááʼ háálá ląʼída éí bitahgóó álílee diyinkʼehgo naʼanish ádaalyaahą́ą biniinaa.

en: And again, I tell the poor, you who’ve not and yet have enough, that you remain from day to day; I mean all of you who deny the beggar, because you haven’t; I’d suggest you say in your hearts that: I don’t give because I havent, but if I had, I’d give.
nv: dóó nááná, nihaa dahojoobáʼí ánihidishní, nihí tʼáadoo leʼé doo nihee dahólóonii dóó ákondi tʼáá ákwíí jį́ bee hinohnáanii nihee dahólǫ́; tʼáá ánółtso doo daʼohtʼíinii biniinaa ááłdishní, ídaʼdókeedii doo baʼnohłéii; díí nihijéí biyiʼdi kódadidoohniił nisin éí: doo tʼáadoo leʼé aa hashníił da háálá tʼáadoo leʼé shee ádin, ndi tʼáadoo leʼé shee hólǫ́ǫgo éí aa deeshnił ńtʼę́ę́ʼ.

en: And again, I say unto the poor, ye who have not and yet have sufficient, that ye remain from day to day; I mean all you who deny the beggar, because ye have not; I would that ye say in your hearts that: I give not because I have not, but if I had I would give.
nv: dóó nááná, nihaa dahojoobáʼí ánihidishní, nihí tʼáadoo leʼé doo nihee dahólóonii dóó ákondi tʼáá ákwíí jį́ bee hinohnáanii nihee dahólǫ́; tʼáá ánółtso doo daʼohtʼíinii biniinaa ááłdishní, ídaʼdókeedii doo baʼnohłéii; díí nihijéí biyiʼdi kódadidoohniił nisin éí: doo tʼáadoo leʼé aa hashníił da háálá tʼáadoo leʼé shee ádin, ndi tʼáadoo leʼé shee hólǫ́ǫgo éí aa deeshnił ńtʼę́ę́ʼ.

en: And again my brothers, I’d call your attention, for I’ve somewhat more to tell you; for look, I’ve things to say concerning what is to come.
nv: dóó nááná, shikʼisóó danohłíinii, náádashíídóołtsʼįįł nisin, háálá łahgo bee nihichʼįʼ hanáádeesdzih; jó áko, náásgóó ádahodooníłígíí bee nihił hodeeshnih.

en: And again my brethren, I would call your attention, for I have somewhat more to speak unto you; for behold, I have things to tell you concerning that which is to come.
nv: dóó nááná, shikʼisóó danohłíinii, náádashíídóołtsʼįįł nisin, háálá łahgo bee nihichʼįʼ hanáádeesdzih; jó áko, náásgóó ádahodooníłígíí bee nihił hodeeshnih.

en: And know that you will be judges of this people, according to the judgment which I shall give to you, which will be just.
nv: dóó nihí naakitsʼáadahí danohłíinii nihił hashneʼ, tʼáá ákótʼéego anáhidootʼáłígíí nihaa deeshłééł éí éí bikʼehgo, díí diné bá ndahwidiyootʼááł.

en: And know ye that ye shall be judges of this people, according to the judgment which I shall give unto you, which shall be just.
nv: dóó nihí naakitsʼáadahí danohłíinii nihił hashneʼ, tʼáá ákótʼéego anáhidootʼáłígíí nihaa deeshłééł éí éí bikʼehgo, díí diné bá ndahwidiyootʼááł.

en: And there was also a great and terrible tempest; and there was terrible thunder, insomuch that it did shake the whole earth as if it was about to divide asunder.
nv: dóó níłtsą́ tʼóó báhádzidgo bił deeyol; dóó tsʼídá yéigo ndaʼdilchʼilgo, wónáasiiʼ nahasdzáánę́ę nayiiłná ałtsʼádooltał nahalingo.

en: It’s through whisperings of the Spirit that the divine nature of a doubter, after gasping for breath, finds peace to breathe again.
nv: doo oodlą́ąnii niłch’i diyinii hazhóó’ógo yałtí’ígíí be’iiná diyinii bee hólónígíí yee yił halne’go ya’ákodínoozį́į́ł.

en: It is through the whisperings of the Spirit that the divine nature of a doubter, after gasping for breath, finds the peace to breathe again.
nv: doo oodlą́ąnii niłch’i diyinii hazhóó’ógo yałtí’ígíí be’iiná diyinii bee hólónígíí yee yił halne’go ya’ákodínoozį́į́ł.

en: And after my brethren and I and all the house of Ishmael had come down to my father’s tent, they gave thanks to the Lord their God; and they offered sacrifice and burnt offerings to him.
nv: dóó shí dóó shikʼisóó dóó ishmael dóó tʼáá átʼé bighan hazʼáanii shizhéʼé biníbaaljįʼ bił náníshkaigo índa, bóhólníihii bidiyin god ahéheeʼ dadííniid; dóó naaldlooshii kǫʼ yee yichʼįʼ náádaʼiisniiʼ.

en: And after I and my brethren and all the house of Ishmael had come down unto the tent of my father, they did give thanks unto the Lord their God; and they did offer sacrifice and burnt offerings unto him.
nv: dóó shí dóó shikʼisóó dóó ishmael dóó tʼáá átʼé bighan hazʼáanii shizhéʼé biníbaaljįʼ bił náníshkaigo índa, bóhólníihii bidiyin god ahéheeʼ dadííniid; dóó naaldlooshii kǫʼ yee yichʼįʼ náádaʼiisniiʼ.

en: And I, Nephi, began to greatly fear pr the Lord should be angry with us, and smite us because of our iniquity, that we should be swallowed up in the depths of the sea; why, I, Nephi, began to speak to them with great soberness; but behold they were angry with me, saying: We won’t that our younger brother shall be a ruler over us.
nv: dóó shí, nephi, tʼáá íiyisíí nísísdzííd tʼáá hazhóʼó bóhólníihii nihá hodoochįįł ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, dóó atínihóleʼ lágo niizį́į́ʼ háálá bąąhági átʼéii baa ńdiideeʼígíí biniinaa, tónteel biyiʼjįʼ kónihóleʼ lágo; ákohgo shí, nephi, tʼáá íiyisíí hazhóʼó bichʼįʼ yáʼniiłtiʼ; ndi shichʼįʼ dahaschįįd, kódaaníigo: nihí éí, nihitsilí doo nihinaatʼáanii nilį́į dooleeł da.

en: And I, Nephi, began to fear exceedingly lest the Lord should be angry with us, and smite us because of our iniquity, that we should be swallowed up in the depths of the sea; wherefore, I, Nephi, began to speak to them with much soberness; but behold they were angry with me, saying: We will not that our younger brother shall be a ruler over us.
nv: dóó shí, nephi, tʼáá íiyisíí nísísdzííd tʼáá hazhóʼó bóhólníihii nihá hodoochįįł ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, dóó atínihóleʼ lágo niizį́į́ʼ háálá bąąhági átʼéii baa ńdiideeʼígíí biniinaa, tónteel biyiʼjįʼ kónihóleʼ lágo; ákohgo shí, nephi, tʼáá íiyisíí hazhóʼó bichʼįʼ yáʼniiłtiʼ; ndi shichʼįʼ dahaschįįd, kódaaníigo: nihí éí, nihitsilí doo nihinaatʼáanii nilį́į dooleeł da.

en: And my eyes have seen great things, yes, even too great for man; therefore I was bidden that I shouldn’t write them.
nv: dóó shinááʼ bee tʼáadoo leʼé ayóó átʼéii nééłʼį́į́ʼ, aooʼ, diné yidoołtséłígíí éí doo yíneelʼáanii ndi; éí bąą éí doo bikááʼ ádíílíił da shiʼdooʼniid.

en: And mine eyes have beheld great things, yea, even too great for man; therefore I was bidden that I should not write them.
nv: dóó shinááʼ bee tʼáadoo leʼé ayóó átʼéii nééłʼį́į́ʼ, aooʼ, diné yidoołtséłígíí éí doo yíneelʼáanii ndi; éí bąą éí doo bikááʼ ádíílíił da shiʼdooʼniid.

en: And when my father saw that the waters of the river emptied into the fountain of the Red Sea, he spoke to Laman, saying: Oh that you might be like this river, continually running into the fountain of all righteousness!
nv: dóó shizhéʼé tó nílínę́ę tónteel łichíiʼgo dah siyínígíí biih yílį́įgo yiyiiłtsą́ągo, kóníigo, laman yichʼįʼ haadzííʼ: o tó nílínígi áńtʼée dooleełę́ę, tʼáá áłahjįʼ yáʼátʼéehii bee nííséeł dooleeł.

en: And when my father saw that the waters of the river emptied into the fountain of the Red Sea, he spake unto Laman, saying: O that thou mightest be like unto this river, continually running into the fountain of all righteousness!
nv: dóó shizhéʼé tó nílínę́ę tónteel łichíiʼgo dah siyínígíí biih yílį́įgo yiyiiłtsą́ągo, kóníigo, laman yichʼįʼ haadzííʼ: o tó nílínígi áńtʼée dooleełę́ę, tʼáá áłahjįʼ yáʼátʼéehii bee nííséeł dooleeł.

en: More than one time, someone said to me after my testimony, “How did you know what I needed to hear so much?”
nv: dóo t’áałáhidi da, t’áa’aaníí bee haasdzígo bik’ijį’, “háiit’áosh ts’ída nísinígíí bee háinidzíí’?”

en: More than once, someone has said to me after my testimony, “How did you know what I so needed to hear?”
nv: dóo t’áałáhidi da, t’áa’aaníí bee haasdzígo bik’ijį’, “háiit’áosh ts’ída nísinígíí bee háinidzíí’?”

en: We need not just one flash of light and comfort, but we need the continuing blessing of communication with God.
nv: doo t’ááłáhídi nihił ch’i’nidláadgo dóó nihitah yáá’áhoot’éé goo bíighada, jó t’ááłajį diyin god bił ałch’į yéelti’go bee nihik’ijóódlíido nidzin.

en: And they were cast into a furnace three times and received no harm.
nv: dóó táadi éí tsídzabiʼdiistłʼííd dóó tʼáadoo ádáádzaaí da.

en: And thrice they were cast into a furnace and received no harm.
nv: dóó táadi éí tsídzabiʼdiistłʼííd dóó tʼáadoo ádáádzaaí da.

en: And when three hundred eighty-four years had passed, we’ad gathered in all the remainder of our people to the land of Cumorah.
nv: dóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan tseebídiin dóó baʼaan dį́į́ʼ ałtso nááhaigo, nihidineʼé tʼah daadziihígíí ałtso áłah ádeiilyaa ńléí cumorahjįʼ.

en: And when three hundred and eighty and four years had passed away, we had gathered in all the remainder of our people unto the land of Cumorah.
nv: dóó táadi neeznádiin dóó baʼaan tseebídiin dóó baʼaan dį́į́ʼ ałtso nááhaigo, nihidineʼé tʼah daadziihígíí ałtso áłah ádeiilyaa ńléí cumorahjįʼ.

en: And after they had been received in baptism, and were wrought upon and cleansed by the power of the Holy Ghost, they were numbered among the people of the church of Christ; and their names were taken, that they may be remembered and nourished by the good word of God, to keep them in the right way, to keep them continually watchful in prayer, relying alone upon the merits of Christ, who was the author and the finisher of their faith.
nv: dóó tó bee dabiʼdiilzį́įʼgo, dóó iiʼsizį́ diyinii bibee adziilii bindaashnish dóó doo bąąh chinígóó ábiilaago índa, christ bisodizin bá hooghan yee dayikahígíí yitah hakááh; áádóó bízhiʼ éí náhádlááh, áko diyin god bizaad yáʼátʼéehii bee bééhániih dóó bee baa áháyą́ą doo biniiyé, áko yáʼátʼééh hońtʼiʼjįʼ deíkáahgo óólzin doo, dóó sodizin tʼáá áłahjįʼ yee ádaa ádahalyą́ą doo, christ bibee ajoobaʼígíí tʼéiyá yadaʼólíigo, éí éiyá beʼoodląʼ bá áyiilaa dóó bá ałtso ííłʼį́.

en: And after they had been received unto baptism, and were wrought upon and cleansed by the power of the Holy Ghost, they were numbered among the people of the church of Christ; and their names were taken, that they might be remembered and nourished by the good word of God, to keep them in the right way, to keep them continually watchful unto prayer, relying alone upon the merits of Christ, who was the author and the finisher of their faith.
nv: dóó tó bee dabiʼdiilzį́įʼgo, dóó iiʼsizį́ diyinii bibee adziilii bindaashnish dóó doo bąąh chinígóó ábiilaago índa, christ bisodizin bá hooghan yee dayikahígíí yitah hakááh; áádóó bízhiʼ éí náhádlááh, áko diyin god bizaad yáʼátʼéehii bee bééhániih dóó bee baa áháyą́ą doo biniiyé, áko yáʼátʼééh hońtʼiʼjįʼ deíkáahgo óólzin doo, dóó sodizin tʼáá áłahjįʼ yee ádaa ádahalyą́ą doo, christ bibee ajoobaʼígíí tʼéiyá yadaʼólíigo, éí éiyá beʼoodląʼ bá áyiilaa dóó bá ałtso ííłʼį́.

en: And he came down by the borders near the shore of the Red Sea; and he traveled in the wilderness within the borders which are nearer the Red Sea; and he traveled in the wilderness with his family, which consisted of my mother, Sariah, and my elder brothers, who were Laman, Lemuel, and Sam.
nv: dóó tónteel łichííʼ yibąąhgóó níyá; dóó tónteel łichííʼ bibąąhgóó doo diné kééhatʼínígi níyá; dóó baʼáłchíní doo diné kééhatʼínígi yił níná, éí éí shimá, sariah, dóó shínaaí, laman, lemuel, dóó sam.

en: And he came down by the borders near the shore of the Red Sea; and he traveled in the wilderness in the borders which are nearer the Red Sea; and he did travel in the wilderness with his family, which consisted of my mother, Sariah, and my elder brothers, who were Laman, Lemuel, and Sam.
nv: dóó tónteel łichííʼ yibąąhgóó níyá; dóó tónteel łichííʼ bibąąhgóó doo diné kééhatʼínígi níyá; dóó baʼáłchíní doo diné kééhatʼínígi yił níná, éí éí shimá, sariah, dóó shínaaí, laman, lemuel, dóó sam.

en: And every one that heard these sayings of mine and didn’t do them shall be likened to a foolish man, who built his house on the sand—

en: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine and doeth them not shall be likened unto a foolish man, who built his house upon the sand—

en: And the words I have written in weakness will be strengthened for them; for it persuaded them to do good; it made their fathers known to them; and it spoke of Jesus, and persuaded them to believe in him, and to endure to the end, which is eternal life.
nv: dóó tʼáá ałtso saad doo dabidziilgóó nááházo yę́ę éí, dabidziilgo bichʼįʼ ádadoolnííł; binahjįʼ naanish yáʼátʼéehii ádeidoolííł; dóó ałkʼidą́ą́ʼ dabizhéʼé yę́ę bił ííshją́ą́ ádadoolnííł; dóó jesus yaa yáłtiʼ, dóó éí deidoodląął, dóó nihookááʼ iiná bijį́įjįʼ daʼoodlą́ągo, éí hoolʼáágóó iiná shódeidoołtʼeełgo yaa halneʼ.

en: And the words which I have written in weakness will be made strong unto them; for it persuadeth them to do good; it maketh known unto them of their fathers; and it speaketh of Jesus, and persuadeth them to believe in him, and to endure to the end, which is life eternal.
nv: dóó tʼáá ałtso saad doo dabidziilgóó nááházo yę́ę éí, dabidziilgo bichʼįʼ ádadoolnííł; binahjįʼ naanish yáʼátʼéehii ádeidoolííł; dóó ałkʼidą́ą́ʼ dabizhéʼé yę́ę bił ííshją́ą́ ádadoolnííł; dóó jesus yaa yáłtiʼ, dóó éí deidoodląął, dóó nihookááʼ iiná bijį́įjįʼ daʼoodlą́ągo, éí hoolʼáágóó iiná shódeidoołtʼeełgo yaa halneʼ.

en: And there was no light seen, neither fire, nor glimmer, neither the sun nor the moon, nor the stars, for so great were the mists of darkness that were upon the face of the land.

en: And whoever knocks, to him he will open; and the wise, and the educated, and the wealthy, who are puffed up because of their education, and their wisdom, and their wealth—yes, they’re those who he despises; and they shall cast these things away, and consider themselves fools before God, and come down in the depths of humility, he won’t open to them.
nv: dóó tʼáá háíshį́į́ dáádílkał neiniłtsʼinígíí, yichʼįʼ ąą íidoolííł; áádóó shił ééhózin nízinígíí, dóó íhoołʼaahígíí, dóó daʼatʼínígíí, háálá ayóó shił ééhózin, dóó íhoołʼą́ą́ʼ dóó ashtʼį́ nízingo éí ádaa haʼniihígíí—aooʼ, díí éiyá tʼáá íiyisíí tʼóó yijoołaah; dóó tʼáá hazhóʼó díí tʼáadoo leʼé nahjįʼ ádayiilaagóó tʼéiyá, dóó tʼáadoo diyin god bidááhdóó tʼóó shá yáhásin niizį́įʼgo, dóó hojoobaʼ áhwiinidzin yę́ę tʼáadoo niizį́įʼgo, éí doo yichʼįʼ ąą íidoolíił da.

en: And whoso knocketh, to him will he open; and the wise, and the learned, and they that are rich, who are puffed up because of their learning, and their wisdom, and their riches—yea, they are they whom he despiseth; and save they shall cast these things away, and consider themselves fools before God, and come down in the depths of humility, he will not open unto them.

en: And there was nothing aside from the power of God, which threatened them all with destruction, could soften their hearts; why, when they saw that they were about to be swallowed up in the depths of the sea they repented of the thing they’d done, so much that they released me.
nv: dóó tʼáá hazhóʼó diyin god bibee adziilii, nabidoołtsiłgo bił ííshją́ą́ ályaago índa, hazhóʼó ntsíńdoohkos; ákohgo, kʼadę́ę tónteel abiłnéehgo índa ádáádzaa yę́ę yąąh bíniʼ dóó beʼiinaʼ łahgo áńdayiidlaa, wónáásdóó shéédadeezhchid.

en: And there was nothing save it were the power of God, which threatened them with destruction, could soften their hearts; wherefore, when they saw that they were about to be swallowed up in the depths of the sea they repented of the thing which they had done, insomuch that they loosed me.
nv: dóó tʼáá hazhóʼó diyin god bibee adziilii, nabidoołtsiłgo bił ííshją́ą́ ályaago índa, hazhóʼó ntsíńdoohkos; ákohgo, kʼadę́ę tónteel abiłnéehgo índa ádáádzaa yę́ę yąąh bíniʼ dóó beʼiinaʼ łahgo áńdayiidlaa, wónáásdóó shéédadeezhchid.

en: And many agreat and notable cities were bsunk, and many were cburned, and many were shaken till the buildings thereof had fallen to the earth, and the inhabitants thereof were slain, and the places were left desolate.
nv: dóó tʼóó ahayóí kin nitsaago dah naazjaaʼą́ą dóó béédahoʼdílzinę́ę táyiʼ góyaa daazlį́į́ʼ, dóó tʼóó ahayóí adahideezkʼą́ą́ʼ, dóó łaʼ éí tsʼídá yéigo ndahasnáhígíí bąą nahasdzáán bikáaʼjįʼ ndahaasdááz, dóó akweʼé kéédahojitʼínę́ę ndaaztseed, dóó kéyah bikáaʼgo doo siláhá da silį́į́ʼ.

en: And they began from that moment forth to call upon his name; therefore God spoke with men and made the plan of redemption known to them, which had been prepared from the foundation of the world; and he made this known to them according to their faith and repentance and their holy works.
nv: dóó wónáásdóó yichʼįʼ sodadilzingo yaa ńdiikai; éí bąą diyin god diné yił halneʼ silį́į́ʼ, dóó nináʼílyáago nahatʼáhígíí yił ííshją́ą́ áyiilaa, éí nahasdzáán álnééhdą́ą́ʼ hashtʼeelyaa; dóó díí éí bedaʼoodląʼ dóó beʼiinaʼ łahgo áńdayiidlaa dóó binaanish diyingo yindaashnishígíí bikʼehgo yił ííshją́ą́ áyiilaa.

en: And they began from that time forth to call on his name; therefore God conversed with men, and made known unto them the plan of redemption, which had been prepared from the foundation of the world; and this he made known unto them according to their faith and repentance and their holy works.

en: And it reminds us that to qualify for those blessings, we must make certain we do not deny them to others: we are to deal justly, never unjustly, never unfairly; we are to walk humbly, never arrogantly, never pridefully; we are to judge righteously, never self-righteously, never unrighteously.
nv: dóó yéé nihiłníhii eíí binahjį’ bee nihik’i dáhozh-doodlíiłgo, nihí ts’ída háiida dóo bich’į’ baa niichį́’í da: nihí ts’ídii íilnííł, t’áa na’níle’diií; nihí jooba’ í’diníilzin, dóo ádaa zííniidíígóó; diyin k’ehjí ánihwiit’ááh, t’áa shí aláah anisht’é niizį́ní.

en: And he told them: On this wise you shall baptize; and there shall be no disputes among you.

en: And he said unto them: On this wise shall ye baptize; and there shall be no disputations among you.

en: And, oh, how our Heavenly Father and we, your sisters, love you for it!

en: Therefore let us go up; let us be strong like unto Moses; for he truly spake unto the waters of the Red Sea and they divided hither and thither, and our fathers came through, out of captivity, on dry ground, and the armies of Pharaoh did follow and were drowned in the waters of the Red Sea.
nv: éí bąą ákǫ́ǫ́ náádiikah; moses nahalingo danihidziil dooleeł; háálá tʼáá aaníí tónteel łichííʼ yichʼįʼ haadzííʼ dóó ałtsʼą́ą́ʼ ąą ádzaa dóó danihizhéʼé yę́ę ąą shijééʼdę́ę́ʼ, łeezh yíłtseiigo, yiyiʼdę́ę́ʼ chʼékai, dóó pharaoh bá ndaabaahii bikééʼ yijahgo dóó tónteel łichííʼ ałchʼįʼ kónádzaago tó ndabistseed.

en: Therefore ye need not suppose that ye can turn the right hand of the Lord unto the left, that he may not execute judgment unto the fulfilling of the covenant which he hath made unto the house of Israel.

en: Therefore they exercised power and authority over Jesus’ disciples who tarried with them, and they casted them into prison; but by the power of the Holy God’s word that was in them, the prisons were split in half, and they went forth doing mighty miracles among them.
nv: éí bąą jesus hastóí náyiizláʼą́ą naakitsʼáadah danilínę́ę hootaakaiyę́ę éí adziil dóó óhólníihii yee yikʼehdadidlį́įʼgo awáalyaa, dóó góneʼ yah adayiiznil; ndi diyin god bizaad bibee adziilii, éí éí biiʼ dahólónígíí biniinaa, awáalyaahą́ą éí ałtso ahiih ndahaasdááz, dóó naanish diyinii ayóó ádaatʼéhígíí éí binaanish ádayósingo diné yitah daakai ńtʼę́ę́ʼ.

en: Therefore they did exercise power and authority over the disciples of Jesus who did tarry with them, and they did cast them into prison; but by the power of the word of God, which was in them, the prisons were rent in twain, and they went forth doing mighty miracles among them.

en: Therefore, I’d suggest that you should see that the Lord truly taught the people, for within the space of three days; and afterward he showed himself to them often, and broke bread often, and blessed it, and gave it to them.
nv: éí bąą, díí éí nihił bééhózin doo laanaa nisin bóhólníihii tʼáá aaníí diné neinitingo, tágí jį́ azlį́į́ʼ; dóó bikʼijįʼ yichʼįʼ ííshjání áʼdiilyaa doo éí tʼáá ahą́ą́h yaa nádááh ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, dóó tʼáá ahą́ą́h bááh nináyitiʼ, dóó yá sońdílzįįh, dóó hatah neikaah ńtʼę́ę́ʼ.

en: Therefore, I would that ye should behold that the Lord truly did teach the people, for the space of three days; and after that he did show himself unto them oft, and did break bread oft, and bless it, and give it unto them.
nv: éí bąą, díí éí nihił bééhózin doo laanaa nisin bóhólníihii tʼáá aaníí diné neinitingo, tágí jį́ azlį́į́ʼ; dóó bikʼijįʼ yichʼįʼ ííshjání áʼdiilyaa doo éí tʼáá ahą́ą́h yaa nádááh ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, dóó tʼáá ahą́ą́h bááh nináyitiʼ, dóó yá sońdílzįįh, dóó hatah neikaah ńtʼę́ę́ʼ.

en: Therefore, when these works and the works that shall be brought among you afterwards will come forth from the Gentiles, to your offspring that will dwindle in unbelief because of iniquity;

en: Therefore, when these works and the works which shall be wrought among you hereafter shall come forth from the Gentiles, unto your seed which shall dwindle in unbelief because of iniquity;

nv: jó háálá, tʼáá háiida tʼáadoo hazhóʼó baa ntsáhákeesí á nahaʼáhígíí éí ałdóʼ tʼáadoo hazhóʼó baa ntsáhákeesí bá nihodootʼááł; háálá naanish áyiilaaígíí éí binahjįʼ bichʼįʼ nʼdoolyééł; éí bąą, tʼáá háiida atíʼáłʼínígíí éí bóhólníihii ałdóʼ atíbidoolííł.

en: Look, I tell you that this thing you’ll teach—repentance and baptism to those who’re accountable and capable of committing sin; yes, teach mothers and fathers that they must repent and be baptized, and humble themselves as their small children, and they will all be saved with their small children.
nv: jó kóndishní díí éí bee naʼńtin doo—iiná łahgo ánáálnééh dóó tó bee alzį́į́h éí bíighahgo béédááhai dóó bąąhági átʼéii íidoolííł yídáághahígíí bichʼįʼ; aooʼ, amá dóó azhéʼé danilínígíí niheʼiinaʼ łahgo áńdaahdlééh dóó tó bee danihiʼdilzį́į́h, dóó nihaʼáłchíní nahalingo hojoobaʼgo ídaʼdółnééh, bidiníigo bínabiníłtin, dóó baʼáłchíní yił yisdáhidookah.

en: Behold I say unto you that this thing shall ye teach—repentance and baptism unto those who are accountable and capable of committing sin; yea, teach parents that they must repent and be baptized, and humble themselves as their little children, and they shall all be saved with their little children.
nv: jó kóndishní díí éí bee naʼńtin doo—iiná łahgo ánáálnééh dóó tó bee alzį́į́h éí bíighahgo béédááhai dóó bąąhági átʼéii íidoolííł yídáághahígíí bichʼįʼ; aooʼ, amá dóó azhéʼé danilínígíí niheʼiinaʼ łahgo áńdaahdlééh dóó tó bee danihiʼdilzį́į́h, dóó nihaʼáłchíní nahalingo hojoobaʼgo ídaʼdółnééh, bidiníigo bínabiníłtin, dóó baʼáłchíní yił yisdáhidookah.

en: But look, that which is of God invites and entices to do good continually; why, every thing which invites and entices to do good and to love God and to serve him is inspired of God.
nv: jó ndi, diyin god bitsʼą́ą́dę́ʼígíí éí tʼáá áłahjįʼ yáʼátʼééh bee ádoolníiłii hágo dóó wóshdę́ę́ʼ yiłní; ákohgo tʼáá ałtsoní yáʼátʼéehii tʼéiyá hágo dóó wóshdę́ę́ʼ hałnínígíí, dóó diyin god ayóí ájóʼní, dóó bá naashnish doo jinízingo áhósinígíí, éí diyin god bitsʼą́ą́dę́ę́ʼ yidiłii átʼé.

en: But behold, that which is of God inviteth and enticeth to do good continually; wherefore, every thing which inviteth and enticeth to do good, and to love God, and to serve him, is inspired of God.
nv: jó ndi, diyin god bitsʼą́ą́dę́ʼígíí éí tʼáá áłahjįʼ yáʼátʼééh bee ádoolníiłii hágo dóó wóshdę́ę́ʼ yiłní; ákohgo tʼáá ałtsoní yáʼátʼéehii tʼéiyá hágo dóó wóshdę́ę́ʼ hałnínígíí, dóó diyin god ayóí ájóʼní, dóó bá naashnish doo jinízingo áhósinígíí, éí diyin god bitsʼą́ą́dę́ę́ʼ yidiłii átʼé.

en: But look, we know he lies to us; and he tells us these things, and he works many things by his crafty arts, that he may deceive our eyes, thinking, perhaps, that he may lead us off into some strange wilderness; and after he’s led us off, he has thought to make himself king and ruler over us, that he may do with us in accordance to his will and pleasure.
nv: jó ndi, nihił béédahózingo éí biyoochʼííd; díí tʼáadoo leʼé yee nihichʼįʼ yáłtiʼígíí, binahjįʼ binaʼadloʼígíí ííłʼį́ tʼóó ahayóí tʼáadoo leʼé ííłʼį́, nihinááʼ bee nihidiʼdoolohígíí, doo kééhatʼínígi doo bééhózin léiʼgi nihodeeshʼish, nízingo ntsékees; áádóó yóó ánihííʼeezhgo, binaatʼáanii dóó bibóhólníihii nishłį́į doo nihóʼní, tʼáá bí íinízin dóó bił yáʼátʼéhígi átʼáo nihinaalnish doo.

en: But behold, we know that he lies unto us; and he tells us these things, and he worketh many things by his cunning arts, that he may deceive our eyes, thinking, perhaps, that he may lead us away into some strange wilderness; and after he has led us away, he has thought to make himself a king and a ruler over us, that he may do with us according to his will and pleasure.
nv: jó ndi, nihił béédahózingo éí biyoochʼííd; díí tʼáadoo leʼé yee nihichʼįʼ yáłtiʼígíí, binahjįʼ binaʼadloʼígíí ííłʼį́ tʼóó ahayóí tʼáadoo leʼé ííłʼį́, nihinááʼ bee nihidiʼdoolohígíí, doo kééhatʼínígi doo bééhózin léiʼgi nihodeeshʼish, nízingo ntsékees; áádóó yóó ánihííʼeezhgo, binaatʼáanii dóó bibóhólníihii nishłį́į doo nihóʼní, tʼáá bí íinízin dóó bił yáʼátʼéhígi átʼáo nihinaalnish doo.

en: But look, my beloved brothers, I judge better things of you, for I judge that you have faith in Christ because of your meekness; for if you don’t have in him then you’re not fit to be numbered among the people of his church.
nv: jó ndi, shikʼisóó ayóí ánihííníshʼníinii, shí éí doo ákódooníił da nisin, háálá aa hojoobaʼ ádeinohsingo biniinaa christ deinohdlą́ nisin; jó doo deinohdlą́ągo éí bisodizin bá hooghan yee dah deíkáhígíí anohtahgo doo bíínóhghah da dooleeł.

en: But behold, my beloved brethren, I judge better things of you, for I judge that ye have faith in Christ because of your meekness; for if ye have not faith in him then ye are not fit to be numbered among the people of his church.
nv: jó ndi, shikʼisóó ayóí ánihííníshʼníinii, shí éí doo ákódooníił da nisin, háálá aa hojoobaʼ ádeinohsingo biniinaa christ deinohdlą́ nisin; jó doo deinohdlą́ągo éí bisodizin bá hooghan yee dah deíkáhígíí anohtahgo doo bíínóhghah da dooleeł.

en: But look, there will be many—at that day when I will proceed to do a great work among them, that I may remember my covenants I have made to the children of men, that I may set my hand again the second time to recover my people, which are of the house of Israel;
nv: jó ndi, tʼóó ahayóí dooleeł—áajįʼ ahoolzhiizhgo shinaanish ayóó átʼéii bitahgóó bee naashnishgo, áko nihookááʼ dineʼé bił ałhadadiʼnishtʼánę́ę béédadeeshnih, áko kʼad naaki góneʼ nínáádideeshnih shidineʼé israel bighandóó danilínígíí ahąąh ánáádeeshdlííł.

en: But behold, there shall be many—at that day when I shall proceed to do a marvelous work among them, that I may remember my covenants which I have made unto the children of men, that I may set my hand again the second time to recover my people, which are of the house of Israel;
nv: jó ndi, tʼóó ahayóí dooleeł—áajįʼ ahoolzhiizhgo shinaanish ayóó átʼéii bitahgóó bee naashnishgo, áko nihookááʼ dineʼé bił ałhadadiʼnishtʼánę́ę béédadeeshnih, áko kʼad naaki góneʼ nínáádideeshnih shidineʼé israel bighandóó danilínígíí ahąąh ánáádeeshdlííł.

en: Look the brother said, What should we do?—because we are cast out of our synagogues, that we cannot worship our God.
nv: jó nikʼis haadzíʼę́ę ádííniid, haash dadiiʼnííł?—háálá nihisodizin bá hooghan biyiʼdę́ę́ʼ chʼínihidiʼneelkaad, áko nihidiyin god doo bichʼįʼ sodadiilzin da.

en: Behold thy brother hath said, What shall we do?—for we are cast out of our synagogues, that we cannot worship our God.
nv: jó nikʼis haadzíʼę́ę ádííniid, haash dadiiʼnííł?—háálá nihisodizin bá hooghan biyiʼdę́ę́ʼ chʼínihidiʼneelkaad, áko nihidiyin god doo bichʼįʼ sodadiilzin da.

en: Look, I remove my garments, and I shake them in front of you; I pray the God of my salvation that he see me with his all-searching eye; why, you will know at the last day, when all men will be judged of their works, that the God of Israel witnessed that I shook your iniquities from my soul, and I stand with brightness before him and am rid of your blood.
nv: jó sheʼééʼ éí ádaadiistsóós, dóó nihidááhdóó yishxáád; shí sodiszin diyin god yisdáshidoołtéełii binááʼ tsʼídá tʼáá ałtsoní yee haisíídii yee shidínóołʼįįł nisingo; ákohgo, kʼadę́ę nihoolzhíishgo nihił béédahodoozįįł, tʼáá ałtso nihookááʼ dineʼé naanish ádayiilaahą́ą binahjįʼ bá ndahwiitʼaahgo, éí israel bidiyin god binááł, nihibąąhági átʼéii shitsʼíís dóó shiyiʼsizíiniidóó yígháád, dóó shitsʼádinídíingo bidááhdóó sézį́, dóó nihidił shąąh ádin.

en: Behold, I take off my garments, and I shake them before you; I pray the God of my salvation that he view me with his all-searching eye; wherefore, ye shall know at the last day, when all men shall be judged of their works, that the God of Israel did witness that I shook your iniquities from my soul, and that I stand with brightness before him, and am rid of your blood.
nv: jó sheʼééʼ éí ádaadiistsóós, dóó nihidááhdóó yishxáád; shí sodiszin diyin god yisdáshidoołtéełii binááʼ tsʼídá tʼáá ałtsoní yee haisíídii yee shidínóołʼįįł nisingo; ákohgo, kʼadę́ę nihoolzhíishgo nihił béédahodoozįįł, tʼáá ałtso nihookááʼ dineʼé naanish ádayiilaahą́ą binahjįʼ bá ndahwiitʼaahgo, éí israel bidiyin god binááł, nihibąąhági átʼéii shitsʼíís dóó shiyiʼsizíiniidóó yígháád, dóó shitsʼádinídíingo bidááhdóó sézį́, dóó nihidił shąąh ádin.

en: Look I tell you, No; and God has not stopped being a God of miracles.
nv: jó shí ánihidishníigo éí, ndagaʼ; dóó diyin god éí tʼah doo álílee naanish niʼkwíiléeh da.

en: Behold I say unto you, Nay; and God has not ceased to be a God of miracles.
nv: jó shí ánihidishníigo éí, ndagaʼ; dóó diyin god éí tʼah doo álílee naanish niʼkwíiléeh da.

en: Look, now it happened that when Jesus had spoken these words he looked round about again on the crowd, and he told them: Look, my time is at hand.
nv: jó, áádóó kʼad kótʼéego jesus saad yee haadzíiʼgo áłah jílínę́ę hatáázghal dóó áhodiʼní: jó, kʼad nikiníyáhą́ą baa hoolzhiizh.

en: Behold, now it came to pass that when Jesus had spoken these words he looked round about again on the multitude, and he said unto them: Behold, my time is at hand.

en: Behold, I say unto you that because I said unto you that I had spent my days in your service, I do not desire to boast, for I have only been in the service of God.
nv: jó, ánihidishní éí háálá nihíká anáshwoʼgo hinishná dííniidígíí, doo bee ádaa hashniihgo ádíshníi da, háálá diyin god tʼéiyá bá naashnish ńtʼę́ę́ʼ.

en: Look, the Lord had shown me great and wonderful things concerning that which must come soon at that day when these things will come forth among you.
nv: jó, bóhólníihii éí ląʼída naanish ayóó ádaatʼéhígíí tʼáadoo hodinaʼgo nihitahgóó ádahodooníiłgo, baa dahodoolzhishígíí dóó bidaʼdoolníłígíí, shił ííshją́ą́ áyiilaa.

en: Behold, the Lord hath shown unto me great and marvelous things concerning that which must shortly come, at that day when these things shall come forth among you.

en: Behold, the way for man is narrow, but it lies in a straight path in front of him, and the keeper of the gate is the Holy One of Israel; and he doesn’t employ a servant there; and there is no other way except by the gate; for he cannot be deceived, for he is known as the Lord God.
nv: jó, diné éí áłtsʼóózígo bá honítʼiʼ, ndi bitsijįʼ éí kʼéhózdongo átʼé, dóó dáádílkał yaa áhályánígíí éí israel beʼayóó átʼéii; dóó doo éí łaʼ bá naalnish da áadi; doo éí náánáłahgo átʼáo yah aʼatiin da anítʼiʼ bidáńdítį́hí góneʼ tʼéiyá; háálá doo éí bidiʼnóotʼah da, háálá bóhólníihii diyin god éí bízhiʼ.

en: Behold, the way for man is narrow, but it lieth in a straight course before him, and the keeper of the gate is the Holy One of Israel; and he employeth no servant there; and there is none other way save it be by the gate; for he cannot be deceived, for the Lord God is his name.
nv: jó, diné éí áłtsʼóózígo bá honítʼiʼ, ndi bitsijįʼ éí kʼéhózdongo átʼé, dóó dáádílkał yaa áhályánígíí éí israel beʼayóó átʼéii; dóó doo éí łaʼ bá naalnish da áadi; doo éí náánáłahgo átʼáo yah aʼatiin da anítʼiʼ bidáńdítį́hí góneʼ tʼéiyá; háálá doo éí bidiʼnóotʼah da, háálá bóhólníihii diyin god éí bízhiʼ.

en: And now, look, I’d speak somewhat to the remnant of this people who’re spared, if it is that God may give them my words, that they may know of their fathers’ things; yes, I tell you, you remnant of Israel’s house; and these are the words I speak:

en: And now, behold, I would speak somewhat unto the remnant of this people who are spared, if it so be that God may give unto them my words, that they may know of the things of their fathers; yea, I speak unto you, ye remnant of the house of Israel; and these are the words which I speak:

en: And now, behold, we’ve written this record according to our knowledge, in the letters which are called among us the reformed Egyptian, being passed down and changed by us, according to our way of speech.

en: Look, my servant will deal prudently; he will be lifted up and extolled and be very high.
